Today was a great day for the greater Lansing area: the Lansing Board of Water & Light held their official celebration to open the Delta Energy Park, a new power plant that will power thousands of homes and businesses in mid-Michigan — all without relying on coal. This plant was instrumental in landing the new GM battery plant in Delta Township, and is a key selling point for a number of other large investments that could, fingers crossed, be coming our way.
It was for that reason that I was surprised to see my opponent at this ribbon-cutting event. He touts his strong opposition to the new GM factory and other incentive deals – he voted *five times* to oppose the new plant and the thousands of jobs it will create in our community.
His remarks were therefore doubly surprising: he said, “we know from those looking to locate facilities for expansion of their growth of their business, energy and energy costs rate very high on the list of considerations... and this will make us far more competitive.”
So despite the fact that he voted to kill the bipartisan deal to attract the very growth he talked about, he seemed to have no problem showing up for a ribbon-cutting and mugging for the cameras.
And that’s not all – he also refuses to tell his constituents how he would have voted on the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law (BIL), which includes $65 billion to upgrade states’ power infrastructure and build low-emissions generation facilities like the one we celebrated today. You can’t run for Congress without telling voters what you believe about the issues they care about.
Here’s the thing: you don’t get to have it both ways. Vote against economic growth if you want, but stand by it and skip the ribbon cutting on a facility fundamental to that growth. Even in an election year. This hypocrisy is precisely what Michiganders can’t stand about politics.

Friend,

We couldn't agree more with President Obama. With our democracy at risk, we need to work as hard as humanly possible to make sure it survives for future generations. Here at the NDRC, we’re well aware of the threat — so here’s some highlights of what we’re doing about it:
1. **Working to help elect pro-democracy candidates.** To date, we’ve endorsed 14 Democracy Defenders who understand how important it is to ensure our democracy thrives in the future. And with the attacks on our system of government ramping up, officials like them could be our last line of defense.

2. **Defending and expanding access to the ballot.** Many in the GOP have been rolling back voting rights for a long time, and their efforts have only escalated in recent years. That’s why we’re working to help make sure everyone understands their rights and pushing for increased protections for voting access.

3. **Stopping election deniers from taking over election infrastructure.** Election deniers are working to corrupt the pool of election workers and administrators with partisan activists who wanted to overturn the results of the 2020 election. Stopping them is critical to ensuring the survival of our democracy.

_All_ of this work is necessary if we’re going to stop attacks on our democracy, but we can’t do any of it without the support of our donors. And with the midterms just weeks away, we need your help now more than ever to keep up the fight.

**So friend, will you answer President Obama’s call to defend our democracy and pitch in anything you can today to support all the work we’re doing at the NDRC?** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Castelli for Congress PO Box 2451, Glens Falls, NY 12801
body:

| | | Peter - This is Dr. Oz.

I've given out a lot of advice on skincare over my long career. But now I'm asking you to put some skin in the game.

Traveling across Pennsylvania, I've heard from thousands of Americans about the daily struggles they face in the Biden era. I'm hearing one thing loud and clear: _addressing those challenges is at the very bottom of Biden 's to-do list._

Instead of focusing on the price of gas, food, and other essentials, Biden and the Democrats are far more concerned about transgender athletes and the Green New Deal.

**NOW** , we're hearing that my leftist opponent, John Fetterman, thinks the administration hasn't gone far enough!

We can't allow John Fetterman to double down on Biden's failed agenda and lead us further down the road to socialism. That's why I'm coming to you for help.

**“BREAKING: Internal Memo Reveals Capitol Police Were Warned BLM from Baltimore Was Bussing in Rioters Disguised as Trump Supporters on Jan. 6”

Patriot, you and I know exactly who BLM and Antifa are. They’re leftist terrorists who leave a wake of destruction wherever they go.

**The Capitol Police knew they were serious trouble...and knew these violent leftist agitators would infiltrate the rally disguised as patriotic supporters of President Donald Trump!
**
They knew, but you haven’t seen BLM or Antifa members thrown into jail.

Oh no, they arrest, harass, and abuse patriots who believe in America and in our Constitutionally protected rights.

**You, I, and our fellow patriots have been betrayed!
**
This trampling of justice and the rule of law must stop!

And that’s where Freedom Watch comes in.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s FOUGHT, and WON, for the American people over 3 decades.

You’ve seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.

I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
**And now I am taking on Biden’s CORRUPT FBI in a class action lawsuit for their ILLEGAL tactics against my clients who were in our Nation’s capital to peacefully protest on January 6th, 2021, but were treated like terrorists in the aftermath.
**
Many of my clients were rounded up, had their homes and businesses violated and broken into, and their property such as cell phones and computers seized WITHOUT PROBABLY CAUSE.

**They were arrested, prosecuted, denied bail, and some even thrown into solitary confinement while awaiting trial!
**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping our fellow Americans in jail without due process...they’re often abused and beaten...they’re blocked from seeing their families...and kept from seeing their lawyers!

At least one January 6 protestor has already died.

A patriot grandmother with cancer was just sentenced to federal prison.

And let me tell you, if you and I don’t fight back against the corrupt politicians, bureaucrats, and law enforcement who are abusing our fellow patriots right now... _they will come for us next._

**[Patriot, please give a vital $5, $10, $25, $50, $100 or more IMMEDIATELY to help fully fund my TWO crucial lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to FREE ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS.
](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl22a8iocor0ol944rkv806n8tkb0vcp5g859gtg_rp22sh2s8i66or4cpj6eo35c9h2bs)**
I can’t stress how important it is to make the most of these historic lawsuits. Lots of other groups talk, but I fight. The January 6 protesters deserve nothing less.

**[Patriot, I’m counting on you for at least a special $25, 50 or more now...but every cent helps. Please give what you can.
](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlavelhmhcgean60a195b2qb7uil3lsdah0t34r0_rp22sh2s8i66or4cpj6eo35c9h2bs)**
Thank you!

With Respect and Gratitude,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: We're suing Twitter and we need your help
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) Dear Peter, I'm not going to beat around the bush... Big Tech has become the censorship arm of the radical left. My team at the Center for American Liberty has recently uncovered evidence of powerful elected politicians colluding with Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Twitter to de-platform and silence conservatives like you and me. **In other words, we 've caught big government using tax-payer funding to silence their political opponents.** And if someone does not immediately stand up against this, the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution will become nothing more than meaningless words on a piece of paper. That's why we launched a lawsuit against Twitter, U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, and a handful of liberal elected officials for their state-sponsored plot to eliminate our First Amendment liberties - _and we need your help to win._ **[Will you join us in our lawsuit against Twitter and Sen. Padilla and help defend the First Amendment?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r)** Let me explain... Like millions of Americans after the 2020 presidential election, conservative activist Rogan O'Handley took to Twitter to express his concerns about the dubious election procedures and skepticism of the results. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) Shortly after the election, many of Rogan's tweets were removed by Twitter and his account was permanently suspended for "violating the government's rules about election integrity." _Hopefully, I don 't need to explain to you that censoring or de-platforming ANY American for their political beliefs or opinions is a gross violation of the First Amendment. _ But it gets much worse... When Rogan tried to figure out why he was censored, he found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence him. You see, Alex Padilla was being considered to fill Kamala Harris' vacated seat in the U.S. Senate - and he was afraid that Rogan's tweets would hurt his image and chances of being appointed. **So, the office of Alex Padilla immediately instructed his press secretary to contact Twitter and shut Rogan up.** **From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department **To:** Twitter **Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post: [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public. Twitter then flagged the post as misinformation, deleted it, and -- a few weeks later -- permanently banned Rogan from the their site. [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) That's why my team and I at the Center for America Liberty are suing Twitter, now-Senator Alex Padilla, California Secretary of State Shirly Weber, and a handful of other liberals for their involvement in this blatant assault on the First Amendment. But the only way we can take on the deep pockets and deep connections of these tyrants is with the help of patriotic Americans like you. [**Will you help us fund this critical lawsuit by sending a generous, tax-deductible contribution of just $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. Two years ago, I founded the Center for American Liberty with the purpose of protecting our First Amendment freedoms and civil liberties from being destroyed by today's left. We've taken on Governor Gavin Newsom in California when he unconstitutionally shut down small businesses, banned people from going to church, and kept millions of children locked up in their homes--out of school--during the pandemic. We've taken on Antifa for viciously assaulting and nearly killing journalist Ando Ngo who exposed Antifa's vile, anarchic plot to destroy the United States and turn it into a socialist utopia. **And now, we 're taking on Twitter, Sen. Alex Padilla, and others for colluding to eliminate Rogan O'Handley's freedom of speech. ** But as a non-profit organization, everything we do to defend our civil liberties is with the generous help of like-minded conservative patriots like you. And this massive lawsuit is expected to cost us over $1,000,000. _After all, we are taking a multi-billion-dollar company, the state of California, and a handful of well-connected politicians._ [**So, can I count on you to help us stand up to Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla by making a tax-deductible contribution of $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) I'm not exaggerating when I say that this is the legal battle that will define our generation - and the future of our country. Will we sit back and allow elitist politicians, billion-dollar corporations, and faceless government agencies to continue to trample our constitutional freedoms? Or will we prove that WE, the American people, are still in control of our own lives? [**Please join us in this critical fight to defend the First Amendment by contributing $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) Sincerely, Harmeet K. Dhillon P.S. For four years, leftist politicians and mainstream media figures would not let go of the bogus and unproven accusation that President Trump colluded with Russia to "steal" the 2016 election. But now that there is clear evidence that a California elected official colluded with big tech to censor conservatives who wanted to comment on the 2020 election those same leftists are dead-silent. I am absolutely fed up with left's hypocrisy, double-standards, and blatantly unconstitutional behavior. [**That 's why I'm urgently asking you to contribute $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty to help us fund our lawsuit against Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) [**DONATE**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) [Please consider supporting our efforts to defend our Constitution with a donation today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61080785:JBo7luVwN:m:1:3253819041:A62935A7509D3B0166B8F65720F45AA1:r) The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization created to fight against growing anti-free-speech and anti-civil liberties trends.

body:
AFA is gearing up for a MASSIVE LEGAL BATTLE with Attorney General Merrick Garland and the DOJ / ATF!

Peter --

The first round of Joe Biden's gun control executive orders goes into effect today, **and AFA is gearing up for a MASSIVE LEGAL BATTLE with Attorney General Merrick Garland and the DOJ / ATF!
** **1.** **Biden 's first Executive Order** makes it a felony to have a pistol brace attached to a firearm, making felons out of the 10-40 million Americans who already own these devices! **2.** **Biden 's second Executive Order** makes it a felony for a gunsmith to work on your homemade (80% lower style) firearm without attaching a serial number to it and notifying the NICS system -- the first step toward outlawing them all together. **3.** **Biden 's third Executive Order**** ** would redefine what a firearm receiver is and would mandate that a serial number be added to upper receivers for ALL future sales, allowing Biden to track them like he does lower receivers. This is the tyrannical government our forefathers warned us about. Not one of these orders was ever voted on by a member of Congress. This is gun control via fiat, pure and simple, designed to let Biden's ATF attack law abiding gun owners! But before I can turn our lawyers loose, I need to know that AFA's legal defense fund can cover the costs. **That 's why I am writing you today, to ask you to consider an immediate donation to help us sue Joe Biden.** | [HELP AFA SUE MERRICK GARLAND IN COURT!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61081659:6Dl1ouVUN:m:1:3331421248:BF03E9D99EAE578B16847B667B6C3BF6:r)
---
While it's impossible for me to know the exact amount that we will ultimately need for this fight, our team expects that we'll need between $75,000 to $100,000 depending upon the number of briefs we'll file!
AFA prefers to fight for freedom using grassroots pressure in state legislatures and in the United States Congress. But we can't use those tactics here. We must take the fight into court.

**And we need to hurry.**

But this will be one hell of a fight. Our lawyers are ready to go, but our legal defense fund is not.
**Please make an immediate donation of $100, $50 or at least $25 today!**
[HELP AFA SUE MERRICK GARLAND IN COURT!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61081659:6Dl1ouVUN:m:1:3331421248:BF03E9D99EAE578B16847B667B6C3BF6:r)

Christopher Dorr, ****President**

body:
We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61081820:JEDiouVYN:m:1:3317145305:54549F2D4F7C1EAD5F01E4BD911AA018:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

\-----------------------------------------------

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61081820:JEDiouVYN:m:1:3317145305:54549F2D4F7C1EAD5F01E4BD911AA018:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61081820:JEDiouVYN:m:1:3317145305:54549F2D4F7C1EAD5F01E4BD911AA018:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It's about more freedom vs. more government control. **It's about whether we serve the government... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

**[Can I count on you for your signature?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61081820:JEDiouVYN:m:1:3317145305:54549F2D4F7C1EAD5F01E4BD911AA018:r)**[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61081820:JEDiouVYN:m:1:3317145305:54549F2D4F7C1EAD5F01E4BD911AA018:r)

body:

We still have a long way to go before Election Day, but I KNOW that I can win because my record beats Marco Rubio's any day.
Recent polls show me TIED with Rubio after months of being behind. This is proof that we can win – but it also means that GOP efforts to defeat me have increased TREMENDOUSLY.
I'm being outspent by the GOP in key areas of Florida right now. And with this race tightening, there's no doubt their attacks on my record will escalate over the coming weeks. subject: We're just getting started
body:

Peter, Last night, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent, and Friend, it's more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I've worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. _**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61082696:JKsyVuVCN:m:1:3331421248:7B97FEACF404541C4B0B4536D3F40A75:r "Stand with me to protect
our state. >>>>")**_

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that's what this fight is all about. _**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61082696:JKsyVuVCN:m:1:3331421248:7B97FEACF404541C4B0B4536D3F40A75:r "Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free. >>>>")**_

**It's not about me, it's not about my opponent, it's about you, your business, your children's education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left's radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers' unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist, you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I've only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. _**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61082696:JKsyVuVCN:m:1:3331421248:7B97FEACF404541C4B0B4536D3F40A75:r "Rush in your support TODAY. >>>>")**_

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business' ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and _**[stand with me in the fight against the Left's schemes and radical agenda.>>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61082696:JKsyVuVCN:m:1:3331421248:7B97FEACF404541C4B0B4536D3F40A75:r "stand with me in the fight against the
Left's schemes and radical agenda. >>>>")**_

Sincerely,__

clean_body: | We thought you might want to see this special message from our friends at Republican Accountability PAC. Friend, As we move closer to November, it’s clear that Donald Trump’s grasp on the party remains strong. Across the country, Big Lie conspiracy theorists have won their primaries for state and federal office. If there is a red wave at the ballot box this November with candidates like these, it could spell disaster for the integrity of future elections and for our nation as a whole. It doesn’t matter if you’re a Republican, a Democrat, or neither: when one party loses touch with reality, it’s bad for all of us. In the coming months, we must make sure the worst anti-democracy candidates never take office. That’s why RAPAC has launched Republican Voters Against Mastriano in Pennsylvania, Republican Voters Against Walker in Georgia, and Republican Voters Against Lake in Arizona. These campaigns feature the stories of real disaffected Republicans who can’t support candidates who lie about our elections. As our research and testing has shown over and over again, these testimonials are the most effective way to reach Republicans who don’t like the direction the GOP is going, but need an extra nudge to break from the party and vote their conscience. Those are the people who made the difference in 2020. They’ll make the difference this year, too. And we won’t stop at these three campaigns, either. In the coming weeks, we plan to launch in even more swing states against even more bad Republican candidates, so stay tuned. The only way to defeat Trumpism is to crush it at the ballot box. Thanks for being alongside us as we work to do just that. ## It's The Same Old Stuff...
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8034.1.3c12509d99e8d3be82eb2295b7dadb0b)
---
I have discovered that in my own life the battles I have fought, such as certain **fears** , **insecurities** and **temptations** continually repeat themselves in the form of _cycles_.
You can probably relate with the cycle of "**Once Again** " or "**Here We Go Again** " when it comes to fighting what the devil comes at you with.
_The devil is not creative_ with what he throws at us, but **he is very persistent**.
Last Sunday, I preached a message at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8035.1.ac644ad48bd82b4a23cddffe92ee702e) on how we can transition from "Once Again" to "Never Again" and walk in victory over what the devil throws at us.
I believe there is a _chain-breaking anointing_ on this message because I saw what took place at both the 9 & 11 am services at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8036.1.df3e6244765371f2694066ea5e8c6b23) when I preached it.
If you have found yourself fighting the same **fears** , **insecurities** and **temptations** over and over again then I want to encourage you to check out this message that I believe will help you walk in the freedom of **NEVER AGAIN**.
Watch the message here: [https://youtu.be/OBoIppahgwc?t=1894](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8037.1.26fe375c3b451734f4cfed9092864d3c)
This upcoming Sunday at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8038.1.50e74e64c55f746ab522eaf4214be2ee), I will continue preaching out of the Book of Genesis on the story of Rebekah giving birth to twins that God describes as "two nations" in her womb.
I will be sharing on the **process of potential**.
God has placed tremendous potential inside of you but to give birth to the potential there is a process for the potential to reach its' purpose.
Join me Sunday at 9 or 11 am CT.
**In-Person** : 4121 S Sheridan Rd Tulsa, OK 74145
**Online** : [Facebook](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8039.1.f5592d9d7a32214d114d752163fac007) or [YouTube](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8040.1.2f78c5a248385e0d96c556d7d67fde45)
Please consider giving financial support to [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8041.1.a2ecbc8d1f03519ca7a4464ddcf76a57) as we engage in the fight for faith and righteousness. You're support helps us, help people. A gift of any size goes a long way!
You can give by visiting: [www.sheridan.church/give](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8042.1.9e60bb2f015653b54ca7d355de4ec963)
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer

## The Church Needs Strong Leaders Now More Than Ever
---
America is in **TROUBLE** because for the most part, the American Church has failed to keep _the main thing, the main thing_. I believe the Church in America is in desperate need of a spiritual revival and at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8057.1.67e29a41c150ae2b616834cb7bfbb67b) we want to do our part. This Fall, we are launching [Sheridan Bible Institute](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8058.1.6f3d98d7d137077db7928ae1c3128aad)! This will be a _one-year program_ designed to **educate** , **equip** and **empower** believers to bring about **real transformation** to our nation. Each semester will consist of six courses. The classes will take place on Tuesday and Thursday evenings starting at 6 pm CT. There will be three classes on Tuesday evening and three classes on Thursday evening with each class being fifty minutes. For the Fall semester, I will be teaching **Old Testament Survey** and **History of Christianity Pt.1**. The other courses will be taught by Instructors that I know have _studied to show themselves approved_. If you would like to **dive deeper into the Word of God** then I want to encourage you to checkout [Sheridan Bible Institute](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8059.1.680791265708933bea730750346f87cd). If you are unable to make the classes in-person at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8060.1.c9f82a0244bbf915d9ed0cd88c3fee54) in Tulsa, OK that is not an issue. Each class will be streamed live online as well as uploaded with a link for our online students. The pricing is **TOTALLY** affordable. Tuition is only $300 per semester (around $100/month). This is an investment that I guarantee will bring about a great return in your life. To learn more and to apply visit: [www.sheridan.church/bibleinstitute](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14153454.8061.1.28aaff23d34eeb9b8b4a84afbcddcf6b)
Classes begin September 6, 2022.

Derek, Our Democratic candidates and elected officials across the Commonwealth are counting on you to ensure that they get to serve in Washington. There’s so much at stake this year. Democrats have an ambitious agenda to build on the progress of the first two years of the Biden-Harris administration. Whether it’s**lowering prescription drug prices, building high-quality affordable housing, protecting a woman’s right to choose, or addressing climate change** , Democrats are hard at work creating a Virginia and a nation that works for everyone. Republicans, currently engaged in zero-sum anti-democratic fighting over the 2020 presidential election results, are less focused, but no less ambitious. We did nothing while our border was left wide open for drugs and criminals to walk into our communities. We refused to fight back when they called us the most terrible names you've ever heard. **Then real, conservative leadership came along. THE NEW RIGHT, as I like to call it. I'm talking about leaders like President Donald Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis. ** **They're not afraid of the left. They're not afraid to fight back. And neither am I.** That's exactly the kind of attitude we need to SAVE AMERICA. That's why I'm bringing that same Trump and DeSantis BDE to Arizona.
---
**[SUPPORT KARI: SAVE AMERICA>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61084144:6NoNvuVLN:m:1:3331421248:EDF9CFB6441E4F3CE5AB07453B6A2E18:r)**
---
Make no mistake... my race for Governor of Arizona is the most critical race in the country. The reason is simple: the crisis at our state border is a crisis for every American. And we cannot afford to lose the battle for border security by electing another socialist in a border state. [**_I AGREE >>_**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61084143:6NoNvuVLN:m:1:3331421248:EDF9CFB6441E4F3CE5AB07453B6A2E18:r) **I promise, on Day 1 --when I take my hand off the Bible after giving the Oath of Office--I will issue a Declaration of Invasion on our Southern Border and we stop people from illegally crossing.** When we see those cartel drones flying across the border, we're gonna shoot them down. I'm also going to blow up the drug tunnels... and I don't care if there's a Narco-Terrorist in there when we do it. And then we're going to finish what President Trump started and FINISH THE WALL. It's a vital security issue for Arizona, but it is about the security of our entire nation. Recently, I even spoke with Ron DeSantis, myself. **He agreed that if I'm in office, Florida will send National Guard troops to help secure our border.** Because that's what it takes to save our country right now. It takes transformative leadership.
---

[**James Judge trounces opponents, winning Republican primary election, now heads to face off against Kathy Castor in November**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=06efec3736&e=00028e5542)
TAMPA, Fla. – James Judge, a Tampa Bay area native, decorated war veteran and owner of a PR and marketing firm based in Tampa, won the Republican primary election on Tuesday in a landslide, becoming the Republican nominee for Florida’s 14th Congressional district.“This is the absolute honor of a lifetime, to have a chance to represent my hometown in our nation’s capital. It’s truly amazing, and may the glory be to God,” Judge said.Judge won the race Tuesday with more than 53 percent of the vote against two opponents and now faces Democrat incumbent Kathy Castor in the general election on Nov. 8.“Make no mistake, the general election is not going to be easy for Kathy,” Judge said. “With a new poll showing this week that three out of four Americans think our country is headed in the wrong direction, inflation soaring, and the fact that Kathy co-sponsored legislation to defund our police, I think Tampa Bay area residents have had enough and believe it’s time to make the career politician walk the proverbial plank.”As Judge heads into the general election, he currently has endorsements from the Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ) and Congressman Ted Yoho (R-FL retired 2021). If Judge wins in November, he will be the first Coast Guard veteran to serve in Congress in more than a decade.More endorsements are expected in the coming weeks.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

body:
[](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=61993b9803934b71839b2ec4464f5955&_e=FcHQjgJix0vH9tv8PHsn5LSKxhwXSFTNSeRxARZnL7fQPJjsTnjW4V6gu1d46jUPmUa8f-fV37r5TyyAWDy9JzzOOCKoln9ttx0dXFgh40Ijd9YMCDHqwEKN06frdiQz_Kuzqz4pP__J8lYELmr-PeiqDjGiyBo1UxskGPB8uk9Pr1xFHeKpQH26aTnxi6bqncU-RbvPoCris7k_BhXPWsSW8qrJZFdbDQETCm4zC-6kPMn0Hy5B6tMQvPoENc97ITG287_10snvTKThENxzt_lfBmWcvod29W5W_4YqPtavwwBW8iqOUC8JOjul70snalmad8t1GOyh-0tdB4hsJuqas5Yhw8wxTMt2Kkv_OBA%3D)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=61993b9803934b71839b2ec4464f5955&_e=FcHQjgJix0vH9tv8PHsn5LSKxhwXSFTNSeRxARZnL7fQPJjsTnjW4V6gu1d46jUPmUa8f-fV37r5TyyAWDy9JzzOOCKoln9ttx0dXFgh40Ijd9YMCDHqwEKN06frdiQz_Kuzqz4pP__J8lYELmr-PTz35TtRdyK1Phdf-lSbanOYo5A7TaoX5zT2oa207DGr63_sS6NdhGUkOyFuunN54NfbfsdvYQSzyYdiri9HPJUWLrE-F1SsX9JFn_TB77Jp69u1bkZIh-SYdUleoY91JVOiN-2wQKMGw90KLBUYcj9xEAkVUagceZPCTOmjwLCm0nATh3qBhjyODdxKdcTmzLuGF03V2Z3lmC9ulCT9Nvs%3D)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=61993b9803934b71839b2ec4464f5955&_e=FcHQjgJix0vH9tv8PHsn5LSKxhwXSFTNSeRxARZnL7fQPJjsTnjW4V6gu1d46jUPmUa8f-fV37r5TyyAWDy9JzzOOCKoln9ttx0dXFgh40Ijd9YMCDHqwEKN06frdiQz_Kuzqz4pP__J8lYELmr-Pf_JO9i4AJheaeOofc7BZXcNx80Eppx62tk0sXye_kmvnUoEu9k8-OVZjye66b9_URPMTNzxZb8NLaGIgYiBE3EJUXZd7WzQqv4KgWYktfAkMYAVK_zZMpzRdh8iOIfzt8_IYYxNDMSMYy7BtSjSS9ZCHPMlENn5tzlJlghHMtNM7mhBIV4UQayqjKCH3JO7U8QBcs4MQZYBKPgxESoXVRM%3D)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here’s how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=61993b9803934b71839b2ec4464f5955&_e=FcHQjgJix0vH9tv8PHsn5LSKxhwXSFTNSeRxARZnL7fQPJjsTnjW4V6gu1d46jUPmUa8f-fV37r5TyyAWDy9JzzOOCKoln9ttx0dXFgh40Ijd9YMCDHqwEKN06frdiQzuCEUfpfCV9qGh2zc-WDdm_Jbni8zc3U6bMWzN7dpAwDDCbj6oiBJR0G-EfoSfy1_EQFa5PgpDlWmxzk4lvFosbwRLLTqkiSFJ3YTRnWVL1gJ7WO9W_aFnC2RXMFKej6XvGbkM1-Q0zI3YEjVsAGomo31ASYb5rXKNJWORfuoGNBa688Ax6BvXmefQdSB3GqRhV472eLbwP3yK27nu5ooKP50hcK022H1FFhseTS7fLs%3D)

In Massachusetts, our Secretary of the Commonwealth is one of the most important office holders when it comes to not only protecting, but advancing, our democracy. It’s a role where the status quo is not good enough - particularly around expanding access to the ballot box, better transparency around public records, promoting civic engagement, and unlocking economic opportunity for small businesses. **That’s why I’m supporting Tanisha Sullivan to be our next Secretary of the Commonwealth. I hope you will, too.** Tanisha’s commitment to service and her leadership in the fight for racial, economic, and social justice have prepared her to usher in the next generation of democratic participation in Massachusetts. Peter, Last night, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent, and Friend, it's more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I've worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. _**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085127:JvenKuVQN:m:1:3253819041:2FDD662E5D372CDECBC79F4C0723E512:r "Stand with me to protect
our state. >>>>")**_

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that's what this fight is all about. _**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085127:JvenKuVQN:m:1:3253819041:2FDD662E5D372CDECBC79F4C0723E512:r "Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free. >>>>")**_

**It's not about me, it's not about my opponent, it's about you, your business, your children's education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left's radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers' unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist, you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I've only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. _**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085127:JvenKuVQN:m:1:3253819041:2FDD662E5D372CDECBC79F4C0723E512:r "Rush in your support TODAY. >>>>")**_

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business' ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and _**[stand with me in the fight against the Left's schemes and radical agenda.>>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085127:JvenKuVQN:m:1:3253819041:2FDD662E5D372CDECBC79F4C0723E512:r "stand with me in the fight against the
Left's schemes and radical agenda. >>>>")**_

Sincerely,__

There was nothing easy about getting to this moment, friend. I grew up as a poor, Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith and belief in opportunity taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "Never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am.
There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate, nor was it easy to work my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
My road to this moment – to winning Florida's Senate primary – was not easy, and there won't be anything easy about defeating Marco Rubio in November. But I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good for my community or of doing good for _you_
**I can't win this race alone, though, friend. The real race begins now, so as we enter this final sprint to Election Day, I need you by my side more urgently than ever.**
[**Please, will you rush $5 or more right now to split between my campaign and Raphael Warnock's to help me flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority? | | Team,

I wanted to reach out to personally thank you for your continued support.

Yesterday’s primary results may have not been what we hoped for, but I’m incredibly proud of what we accomplished.

Together, we built a different kind of campaign — one that embraced creativity, compassion, and joy. We forged our own path that wasn’t dictated by D.C. consultants.

This people-powered movement could not have done it without you. From the beginning, your grassroots support helped build this team into a first-class campaign.

We may not have won last night, but our work doesn’t stop now.

I’ll never stop fighting for universal healthcare and reproductive rights. Our efforts to defend the LGBTQ+ community and prioritize the climate crisis cannot end with this primary.

Now, we turn our eyes toward the November election. We must do everything possible to win this seat for Democrats.

The Republican nominee — Laurel Lee — is a far-right DeSantis ally and we can’t let her take her radical beliefs to D.C.

Thank you for everything. We may have come up short, but I’ll always be grateful for your continued support.

Eddie Geller

name: Charlie Crist
subject: I need your help to defeat Ron DeSantis, the most dangerous governor in America
body:
Hi Derek, my name is Charlie Crist, and I just became the Democratic nominee for governor of Florida.
My opponent? Gov. Ron DeSantis, one of the most dangerous Republicans nationwide.
Ron DeSantis has been using Florida as a testing ground for some of the most cruel and divisive culture war tactics of the last two years. He has been setting himself up as a likely presidential contender, and it’s been working.
DeSantis signed one of the first vile “Don’t Say Gay” bills. He attacked Disney and the Special Olympics when they opposed his policies. He’s even created an “elections police” unit that people fear will be more about voter intimidation than voter protection.
DeSantis’s next act is to run for president in 2024, and that’s why I’m writing to you today. This election is our last, best chance to stop Gov. DeSantis’s national ambitions and get Florida back on track. We can accomplish both by defeating him on November 8th, so I hope you’ll make a contribution today to split between my campaign for governor and CommonGood. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220824_CGVA_Crist]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220824_CGVA_Crist&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220824_CGVA_Crist&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220824_CGVA_Crist&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220824_CGVA_Crist&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220824_CGVA_Crist&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220824_CGVA_Crist]
By using the governorship as a stepping stone to run for president in 2024, DeSantis has shown he doesn’t have Florida’s best interests at heart.
But I’ve always put Floridians first. From my time as a state senator to serving as Florida’s 44th governor, I’ve lived my life by the Golden Rule, working to build unity rather than fueling division.
Fortunately, Floridians are waking up to Ron DeSantis’s horrible agenda. Multiple polls have shown me either neck and neck with him or outright beating him, so I know this fight is winnable. DeSantis only won in 2018 by 0.4% in 2018. A recent Axios article said “Florida swing voters view Ron DeSantis as too extreme.”
Beating DeSantis won’t be easy, but nothing worth doing ever is.
Together, we can make Ron DeSantis a one-term governor and ensure he never steps foot anywhere near the White House. Can I count on you for a donation that will be split between my campaign and CommonGood? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cc?refcode=20220824_CGVA_Crist]
Thank you,
Charlie

body:

Peter, Last night, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent, and Friend, it's more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I've worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. _**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085169:JrDrDuVUN:m:1:3317145305:D6485A28C2A005CE329AC413D1C1135E:r "Stand with me to protect
our state. >>>>")**_

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that's what this fight is all about. _**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085169:JrDrDuVUN:m:1:3317145305:D6485A28C2A005CE329AC413D1C1135E:r "Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free. >>>>")**_

**It's not about me, it's not about my opponent, it's about you, your business, your children's education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left's radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers' unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist, you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I've only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. _**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085169:JrDrDuVUN:m:1:3317145305:D6485A28C2A005CE329AC413D1C1135E:r "Rush in your support TODAY. >>>>")**_

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business' ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and _**[stand with me in the fight against the Left's schemes and radical agenda.>>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085169:JrDrDuVUN:m:1:3317145305:D6485A28C2A005CE329AC413D1C1135E:r "stand with me in the fight against the
Left's schemes and radical agenda. >>>>")**_

Sincerely,__

I’m incredibly thankful and honored by last night’s victory with over 65% of the vote [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh] and deeply grateful to the voters across this state who put their trust in me and our campaign. This race is not about any party's platform or any one ideology, this campaign is about Oklahomans.. Bringing Logic Back to Politics is not a half-hearted clever slogan, it is the only way we are going to solve the most complex issues of our time. We have [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh] to work together.
My opponent, James Lankford, has consistently shown that he is unwilling to confront the disinformation and extreme viewpoints that divide and threaten the foundation of our country. He has proven that he is not fit, nor qualified to lead.
James Lankford does not represent you. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh] He does not represent veterans, women, low-income individuals, marginalized groups, or even our rural communities. James Lankford represents himself, his own views, and his wealthy donors in Washington.
Contribute Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh]
Now, I need your help. Lankford’s campaign has been doing this for a long time and it will take all Oklahomans joining together to overcome [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh] what may seem like limitless funds from special interest [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh] groups and dark money. We know it will be an uphill battle, but we also know victory is possible in November.
I am asking for your help to knock on doors, have hard conversations with your friends and family, and most of all vote like our democracy depends on it. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/msh] Quite frankly, it does.
Let's get to work!
Madison Horn

name: Val Demings
subject: I'm officially the Democratic nominee
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
We did it!
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220824-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220824-6960&refcode2=6960_434096_6hfqaR&akid=6960%2E434096%2E6hfqaR)

We did it, Derek:**I'm officially the Democratic nominee in Florida's critical Senate race, and it's all thanks to the overwhelming support of this grassroots team.**
This is a massive step forward in our movement to flip Florida blue, but the road ahead will be the toughest yet — with recent polls showing Marco Rubio and me _tied_ heading into the general election, we can WIN.
**[But in a race this tight, every dollar will make a difference. If you are committed to flipping Florida blue and defending our Senate majority, I'm personally asking you to become one of my first general election donors by rushing $5 now to split between my campaign and John Fetterman's campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220824-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220824-6960&refcode2=6960_434096_6hfqaR&akid=6960%2E434096%2E6hfqaR)**
There was nothing easy about getting to this moment, Derek. I grew up as a poor, Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith and belief in opportunity taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "Never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am.
There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate, nor was it easy to work my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
My road to this moment — to winning Florida's Senate primary — was not easy, and there won't be anything easy about defeating Marco Rubio in November. But I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good for my community or of doing good for _you_.
**I can't win this race alone, though****, Derek. The real race begins now, so as we enter this final sprint to Election Day, I need you by my side more urgently than ever.**
**[Please, will you rush $5 or more right now to split between my campaign and John Fetterman's campaign to help me flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority? Every dollar you can chip in today will help us start the general election as strong as possible.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220824-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220824-6960&refcode2=6960_434096_6hfqaR&akid=6960%2E434096%2E6hfqaR)**

I am so grateful for every bit of your support. Thank you.
— Val Demings

I want to make sure you have the facts on my opponent, Kari Lake, when it comes to the right to a safe, legal abortion.
* Kari Lake has voiced support for Arizona’s Civil War era abortion law — which criminalizes abortion in our state — calling it “great.”

* She has said that abortion pills should not be legal.

* She has promised that as governor, she would sign extreme anti-abortion legislation into law “in a heartbeat.”

That is where Kari Lake and countless dangerous candidates across the country stand. Now, I want to be very clear about where Gretchen Whitmer and I stand on this issue:

**We are unwavering in our support of choice. As Arizona’s next governor, I will use my veto pen to block any legislation that further compromises the right to choose, and Gretchen Whitmer will continue to fight like hell to defend choice. And we will do everything in our power to secure these rights for the next generation.**

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Many people said this day would never come
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren Democrats
body:
I’m grateful to everyone who’s been organizing and fighting to make this happen. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49680779/363108493/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ7S_STU_E_20220824_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzJmOTJlYy1kOTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Y8fNfSDhsfBdnX_poQ8jyl0lDyxSi9VAtaib2adQTSY=&emci=70ed8535-b823-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ac2f92ec-d923-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)
---
We’ve been working towards this day for a long time — **President Biden has used his executive authority to cancel up to $20,000 of student debt for millions and millions of Americans.** This is one of the largest consumer debt reductions in American history. This is what it means to have a government that works for the people. And this is why we persist — because when we fight, we win. I’m grateful to everyone who’s been organizing and fighting to make this happen. Thank you for being a part of this grassroots movement. This one means a lot to me. I got my college degree at a state school that only cost $50 a semester, and it opened a million doors for me, but that opportunity just doesn’t exist today. So when I got to the Senate, the first bill I introduced was to make student loans more affordable so that Americans would not continue to get crushed by debt. And when I was running for president, I proposed canceling student debt to clear the decks and jumpstart opportunity. Alongside leaders and advocates and supporters like you, I’ve called for President Biden to use his executive authority to get this done. And now he’s made it happen. I’m going to continue working with the Biden administration to reform our higher education system. In a twenty-first century economy, it’s never been more critical for students to continue their education after high school — and technical schools, community colleges, and public universities need to be within reach for every family. And we’ve also got to make sure that everyone who’s eligible gets this relief as quickly as possible. [_**You can find more details and learn what this relief plan could mean for you here at StudentAid.gov.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49680780/363108494/-2090096060?refcode=EMZ7S_STU_E_20220824_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzJmOTJlYy1kOTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Y8fNfSDhsfBdnX_poQ8jyl0lDyxSi9VAtaib2adQTSY=&emci=70ed8535-b823-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ac2f92ec-d923-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908) But today, let’s take a moment and celebrate this milestone. President Biden’s action to cancel a big chunk of student debt is a huge step forward for working people. For people who didn’t come from a family that could write a big check, but still did what they had to do to continue their education. For people who helped a child or grandchild pay for school and ended up having their Social Security checks garnished. For people who may not have been able to finish their degree, like around 40% of borrowers, because life got in the way, and would now have to pay off loans with what they could earn on a high school diploma. This is a win — and it paves the way for even more victories to come, if we keep fighting side by side. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

clean_body: I’m grateful to everyone who’s been organizing and fighting to make this happen. | | | We’ve been working towards this day for a long time — President Biden has used his executive authority to cancel up to $20,000 of student debt for millions and millions of Americans. This is one of the largest consumer debt reductions in American history. This is what it means to have a government that works for the people. And this is why we persist — because when we fight, we win. I’m grateful to everyone who’s been organizing and fighting to make this happen. Thank you for being a part of this grassroots movement. This one means a lot to me. I got my college degree at a state school that only cost $50 a semester, and it opened a million doors for me, but that opportunity just doesn’t exist today. So when I got to the Senate, the first bill I introduced was to make student loans more affordable so that Americans would not continue to get crushed by debt. And when I was running for president, I proposed canceling student debt to clear the decks and jumpstart opportunity. Alongside leaders and advocates and supporters like you, I’ve called for President Biden to use his executive authority to get this done. And now he’s made it happen. I’m going to continue working with the Biden administration to reform our higher education system. In a twenty-first century economy, it’s never been more critical for students to continue their education after high school — and technical schools, community colleges, and public universities need to be within reach for every family. And we’ve also got to make sure that everyone who’s eligible gets this relief as quickly as possible. But today, let’s take a moment and celebrate this milestone. President Biden’s action to cancel a big chunk of student debt is a huge step forward for working people. For people who didn’t come from a family that could write a big check, but still did what they had to do to continue their education. For people who helped a child or grandchild pay for school and ended up having their Social Security checks garnished. For people who may not have been able to finish their degree, like around 40% of borrowers, because life got in the way, and would now have to pay off loans with what they could earn on a high school diploma. This is a win — and it paves the way for even more victories to come, if we keep fighting side by side. clean_body: It’s so important that the DNC is well-funded heading into the midterm elections. | | Down the street from where I live in Scranton is a house inscribed with a note: “From this house to the White House with the grace of God.” Derek, this is the childhood home of my dear friend, President Joe Biden. An Irish Catholic kid from Scranton, Joe has never forgotten where he came from -- and it’s this upbringing that inspired his campaign promise to rebuild the backbone of America: the middle class. Joe and Kamala have spent the last two years doing just that: delivering critical legislation like the Inflation Reduction Act to lower costs for workers and families not just here in Scranton but nationwide. This work is so important -- and I know that Joe is so grateful for everything this grassroots team has done to help build a better America. But we can't continue our work without you. | Friends,
I want to thank everyone for their continued support of my campaign. Team Vikram continues to gain strength and momentum across every county in the state. The attention we are generating is noteworthy. The Democrats, other candidates, and even establishment leaders are feeling threatened by our momentum and we are increasingly the focus of attacks. Our honest, no-nonsense approach to focusing on the issues affecting all Granite Staters and Americans has been resonating.
The campaign launched a new television ad earlier this week, one that has produced an extraordinary reaction. Click below to see the ad. As everyone who pays attention to politics is aware, television is expensive. We need support to keep the momentum going through primary day.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: How TV ads really work: a deep dive
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220824&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220824&amount=28]
Team,
One of the most important parts of running a campaign is getting advertisements up on TV – especially in this election. In addition to our massive door-to-door efforts and our district events, they’re just about the best way to reach voters in our new district. Michigan still watches plenty of TV.
So today I thought I’d give you a bit of a behind-the-scenes look at how exactly this part of the campaign works, and a recent development that has thrown a bit of a wrench into things.
We purchase TV advertisements directly from the television stations, who set their own prices. Pretty straightforward, but here’s where I’ll get into the weeds: in the 60 days leading up to the general election, by law TV stations must charge candidates the “Lowest Unit Rate” to advertise. That’s September 9th - November 8th. Essentially, that means that in the 60 days leading up to the election, stations are not allowed to charge candidates exorbitant rates to communicate with voters – even if demand for ad time is high.
But, this rule only applies to candidates themselves – not to any Super PAC or organization that might be running ads on their behalf. The outside organizations continue to pay market rates for advertisements – which increase as Election Day gets closer, and more and more entities are vying for a finite amount of TV time.
With the amount of spending we’ve seen in preparation for the fall, we estimate that market rates for those outside organizations could be *9 times* as expensive as the candidate rate. That’s why your money goes a lot further when you contribute directly to a campaign, rather than an organization.
Where things can get complicated is in the few weeks before that 60 day window begins. Before September 9th, stations can charge candidates whatever prices they want. I’ve had three campaign ads up on TV starting on July 5th (you can see them here) [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] . But now that we’re approaching that 60 day window, the price to keep those ads on the air has skyrocketed.
Last week, rates jumped THREE TIMES AS HIGH as they will be between September 9th and the election – all because television stations are capitalizing on being able to set their own prices in the next few weeks.
For a year and a half, I’ve stressed the importance of early money and how it allows us to be nimble in the event of unforeseen issues. And waking up to find out TV time has jumped to 3 times more expensive than it was yesterday is what we call an unforeseen issue.
Because of the generosity of folks who have already donated, this is a change we can absorb. But it does force us to make changes in our budget. We're currently working to make up for the more expensive TV time, which is the principal reason I’m emailing you today.
Any chance you’d be willing to chip in to help my ads stay on the air at the same frequency? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220824&amount=28] That would help tremendously, as well as with any more curveballs between now and Election Day.

name: Macky Stafford
subject: Will you volunteer for the Peroutka campaign?
body:
Peroutka is now the GOP candidate for Attorney General of MD. We cannot be complacent. We need your help to win the final victory!
|
---
Greetings Peroutka Supporters! After our landslide win in the Primary Election, we are extremely encouraged. We the People have made our voices heard. We want change. With only 11 weeks to go until the General Election, we are very optimistic, but we are also realistic in knowing that we have a lot of work to do. We truly need all hands on deck until God grants Michael victory in November. _**Are you willing to get involved? **_ You are receiving this message because you have contacted our campaign at some point. _**Who better to help fight for victory than those who of you who have already shown interest in the Peroutka Campaign? **_ Data show that the two most effective methods of winning elections are **door knocking and literature drops.** Contrary to popular belief (and what is easy and comfortable) it is not talking about the election in person or on social media with like minded souls. **It is grassroots efforts that win. We are in desperate need of volunteers. ** We will provide absolutely everything you need to make this task easy and rewarding and even fun:
* **Quick and easy training to explain what to do, how to do it, what to say, even a script if you want one**
* **The walk list of where to go**
* **Peroutka palm cards**
* **Other volunteers to partner up with!**

Door knocking also includes drivers who can manage the navigation and data, they don’t even have to get out of the car, so if that appeals to you more than walking up to the door, we need you, too! If you are disgruntled with the state of affairs in Maryland and you want to see Michael in office, please take action. Email [Macky@patriots4Peroutka.com](mailto:Macky@patriots4Peroutka.com) (or reply to this email) with this information:
* **Your name**
* **What county you live in**
* **Dates of what weekends or weekdays you can commit to door knocking between now and Nov 8th.**

We need you. If not you, then who? _**We look forward to hearing back from you!**_

After our landslide win in the Primary Election, we are extremely encouraged. We the People have made our voices heard. We want change. With only 11 weeks to go until the General Election, we are very optimistic, but we are also realistic in knowing that we have a lot of work to do. We truly need all hands on deck until God grants Michael victory in November. Are you willing to get involved? You are receiving this message because you have contacted our campaign at some point. Who better to help fight for victory than those who of you who have already shown interest in the Peroutka Campaign? Data show that the two most effective methods of winning elections are door knocking and literature drops. Contrary to popular belief (and what is easy and comfortable) it is not talking about the election in person or on social media with like minded souls. It is grassroots efforts that win. We are in desperate need of volunteers. We will provide absolutely everything you need to make this task easy and rewarding and even fun: Quick and easy training to explain what to do, how to do it, what to say, even a script if you want one The walk list of where to go Peroutka palm cards Other volunteers to partner up with! Door knocking also includes drivers who can manage the navigation and data, they don’t even have to get out of the car, so if that appeals to you more than walking up to the door, we need you, too! If you are disgruntled with the state of affairs in Maryland and you want to see Michael in office, please take action. Email mailto:Macky@patriots4Peroutka.com (or reply to this email) with this information: Your name What county you live in Dates of what weekends or weekdays you can commit to door knocking between now and Nov 8th. Macky Stafford** Campaign Coordinator, Peroutka for Attorney General, State of Maryland 410-336-9894 | | | | | | Patriots 4 Peroutka, 151 Longfellow Drive, Millersville, MD 21108 |

I'm locked in on winning this election, Friend. The Democrats have shown time and again, how much they have failed this country and I refuse to allow them to gain anymore power to control our lives.

_I 'm running because I believe in **common sense policies.**
I'm running because I believe in **LOW taxes and LESS government control.**
And I'm running because I believe that the American Dream my parents once attained is **growing further and further out of reach.**_

**Democrats have continued to funnel millions (and I mean literally millions) of dollars to my far-Left opponent** to stop any Republican momentum and I need your help so we can respond.

1. Let a Pelosi-Endorsed candidate continue to outraise us and outspend us on TV until she wins Florida and the Senate.
2. **We can start working like a team to stop the Democrats from running our country into the ground.**

Marco

I'm sick and tired of people saying that Florida isn't going to be a tight race, because clearly, it is. This poll is the latest proof that the Democrats' plan is working. Dear Peter,
Before I say anything else, I want to say thank you.
Even though yesterday’s results weren’t what we’d hoped, I’m amazed by the team we built. I’m amazed by the hard work you’ve all put in over the past year. And I’m so grateful for everyone who stood with me in this fight. And I promise you this: our fight isn’t over.
We need to make Ron DeSantis a one-term governor, and it’s going to take all of us to get it done. So, while I’m disappointed, I will join Charlie Crist in the fight for a free, safe, and prosperous Florida. And I hope you’ll join us, too.
I’m forever grateful for your faith in my leadership and your commitment to putting Florida on a better path forward towards Something New .
I’m confident that together, we can give Floridians the future we deserve.
With gratitude,
Nikki
