subject: UPDATE: President Biden's historic announcement on student debt
body:
| | Friend, President Biden just made a long-awaited announcement on the future of student debt: On top of the payment pause being extended to December 31, **borrowers who make less than $125,000 a year will receive up to $10,000 in federal student loan debt cancellation. ** **Not just that — President Biden announced that Pell Grant recipients will receive up to $20,000 in federal student loan debt cancellation.** President Biden also announced that if you have undergraduate loans on an income-drive repayment, you’ll be able to cap the repayment at 5% of your monthly income. This is huge. By canceling at least $10,000 for these eligible Americans, the Biden administration is eliminating the federal student loan debt of roughly a third of borrowers. The Biden administration and Democrats in Congress have been leaders on student debt. Since President Biden took office, no American has been obligated to pay their federal student loan payments. And with today’s announcement, President Biden and Democrats are continuing that leadership. **Today, it’s never been more clear that when young people elect leaders that hold similar values to us, real change is enacted. ** [Act now: Volunteer with us as we work to ensure this progress continues by advocating for progressives up and down the ballot this midterm election season.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49683156/363117896/-1986654109?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MWZhMzBjMC1lMTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9V5sYZO-6_Xfj_D-Wtga51FA15PxLpp0HCBtIpqad5k=&emci=ec777907-c523-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=41fa30c0-e123-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172) **This victory is because of the pressure and work from organizers and activists like yourself.** You shared your stories, signed petitions, and showed up on the ground to hold President Biden to his promise of canceling federal student loan debt. **And the actions of President Biden and Democrats show us that they’re listening. ** For millions of Americans, this announcement from President Biden is life-changing. Without the burden of student debt, so many Americans will be able to start building the lives they’ve envisioned. Americans deserve to see this progress continue. clean_body: | | Friend, President Biden just made a long-awaited announcement on the future of student debt: On top of the payment pause being extended to December 31, borrowers who make less than $125,000 a year will receive up to $10,000 in federal student loan debt cancellation. Not just that — President Biden announced that Pell Grant recipients will receive up to $20,000 in federal student loan debt cancellation. President Biden also announced that if you have undergraduate loans on an income-drive repayment, you’ll be able to cap the repayment at 5% of your monthly income. This is huge. By canceling at least $10,000 for these eligible Americans, the Biden administration is eliminating the federal student loan debt of roughly a third of borrowers. The Biden administration and Democrats in Congress have been leaders on student debt. Since President Biden took office, no American has been obligated to pay their federal student loan payments. And with today’s announcement, President Biden and Democrats are continuing that leadership. Today, it’s never been more clear that when young people elect leaders that hold similar values to us, real change is enacted. This victory is because of the pressure and work from organizers and activists like yourself. You shared your stories, signed petitions, and showed up on the ground to hold President Biden to his promise of canceling federal student loan debt. And the actions of President Biden and Democrats show us that they’re listening. For millions of Americans, this announcement from President Biden is life-changing. Without the burden of student debt, so many Americans will be able to start building the lives they’ve envisioned. Americans deserve to see this progress continue. We’re going to continue to fight for economic relief for young people, and elect candidates that champion this fight. Today, we’re celebrating this win. Tomorrow, we’ll be back out on the ground to continue this momentum toward the 2022 midterm elections. Will you join us? | "CTA Button" Thank you for everything you do, NextGen America | NextGen America 268 Bush St. #2919 San Francisco CA 94104-3503 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

body:
https://www.catherineforcongress.com [https://www.catherineforcongress.com]
Thank You!
As the final votes are tallied and absentees opened in the coming days, I wanted to take a moment and thank each and every one of you for participating in the electoral process. Running for office is not an easy thing and although we are disappointed in the results, I am beyond grateful for the opportunity to meet old and new friends to talk about what issues matter the most, and the end of a campaign shouldn’t stop those conversations from happening.
I congratulate Congressman Bowman on his primary win, look forward to working with him, and hope that he will address the issues highlighted by our challenge. We will pull together, as Democrats must, in preparation for the November general election.
Thank you to my campaign team for working so incredibly hard to get our message out, recruited volunteers, and made sure that every voter had a voice in this election. And my deepest gratitude to the volunteers and supporters who gave so much of themselves in these past weeks. We had only half of the time, and yet we ran a competitive campaign that returned the most votes by far for the investment in time and money, than anyone in the race. This was possible because of you .
Thank you to my husband, David, for being there for me and our family. You’ve been a comfort, provided counsel, and been by my side on this journey and I couldn’t be more grateful that we have you in our lives.
Our democracy works when we all participate and despite the challenges set in front of us, when conditions were never ideal, you all still showed up. And that’s what I can promise you, I’m going to always show up. I hope to see you out there.
-Catherine

It costs Herschel’s campaign **$2 MILLION A WEEK** just to get his message out statewide. Raphael Warnock has enough money in his campaign war chest to bombard the Georgia airwaves without raising another penny! **[The only way we will level the playing field is if every person reading this email chips in $5 or $10 to Herschel’s campaign. $5 or $10 may not seem like a lot, but when conservatives join together, each donation adds up quickly.](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=fe2117d7bb864a998dc83973140584da&_e=OVNerOOV3rmN6FhNHm3eU7iSwXElxBLlVAZpISUD89EcEZSOZZFDIXw70rgqZ8Sn2nUR_8x7KuLlfp4c2Z92_X2UpkvQATJXBKd_dg7-plNEHvO-zXXUmMTCoabzWLeX4X2PuV5n3bJZyu-SwBm6cfaM1w4cLvGeZAcMrnWLTHxQ6LS-KqxXBge79a0X3li_3dBSRHcyVmxJNzyqhiIqbg52rNYRAbFc2--bx6oYvB9LYqF7VRAgMn2kjoHYG2Qz50bswJUIvKoAadPBbH_xwVL3pW0A6zpzEUnRL_ckG2GrHVRRzB_9EIa6eMMzkBBeenN5vxpawF5_fJP2HzQy592cIjlAmXZZ3YaoR-F1HYM6iQZoQ9mlFdqTwan8Rsqxsyy7tYHrpt3P2vS-pQV23I_mmtdM0ywt6rsy7Q09eUY%3D) ** **WE CAN DO THIS — but only if everyone does their part. ** So whether you can give $5 or $500, please read Herschel’s email and donate right away so we can flip this seat from **BLUE** to **RED** and take back control of the U.S. Senate! I had hoped it wouldn't come to this, **but I'd prefer to be the one to tell you rather than let the Democrats leak the news to the mainstream media.**

As a result of the tough fundraising environment Republicans are seeing across the nation, **we're not raising enough money to run the campaign that we need to be running.** That means we've had to make some hard decisions. Today we made the toughest call we've had to make since last August. We don't have enough money in the bank to keep our TV ads on air. As of this morning, our ads are no longer running across Georgia.
**Meanwhile, our opponent Raphael Warnock has more cash than he knows what to do with.** He has more than $22 million in the bank and is raising MILLIONS MORE each WEEK. While our campaign doesn't have the money to keep our ads running, Raphael Warnock could run ads for the next 11 weeks _without raising another dollar._ **I need your help. The more money we raise today, the sooner we can get back on the air.**

clean_body: | | | Dear friend, I’m sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but we have to face the facts. Democrat Senator Raphael Warnock is raising money hand over fist for his Senate race in Georgia. Meanwhile, even though super star Herschel Walker is one of the top Republican fundraisers in the country, he had to pull down his TV ads to save money for the final stretch. That means Georgia voters are not hearing his side of the story right now. And we need to fix that right away. You see, Georgia is an expensive state for running television ads. It costs Herschel’s campaign $2 MILLION A WEEK just to get his message out statewide. **Atlanta, GA **– Tea Party Patriots Action (TPPA) announced today that it filed a complaint for “unethical and prejudicial conduct” against Judge Bruce E. Reinhart, the** ** judge who approved the warrant to search President Trump’s residence. The complaint accuses Judge Reinhart of having a “conflict of interest and a pattern and history of hostility to President Trump.” The complaint then lists seven “undisputed facts” supporting the accusation. The complaint was filed in the Judicial Council of the Eleventh Circuit. Tea Party Patriots Action Honorary Chairman Jenny Beth Martin released the following statement: “Judge Reinhart acted unethically in approving the warrant to search President Trump’s residence. Judge Reinhart is a Democrat who donated to former President Obama. The judge publicly denigrated former President Trump in social media posts. Just two months ago, he recused himself from a lawsuit involving President Trump in his suit against Hillary Clinton, citing a ‘conflict of interest.’ He has a history of ethical issues, most notably his conduct during the Jeffrey Epstein investigation and prosecution. He should be disciplined and removed as a federal magistrate. The entire episode involving the search of former President Trump’s home threatens the principle of ‘equal justice under law’ and the confidence of the American people in an unbiased judiciary.”

clean_body: We had to pull our ads off the air, so Raphael Warnock has the airwaves to himself in the race that will determine control of the Senate. | Fellow American, I had hoped it wouldn't come to this, but I'd prefer to be the one to tell you rather than let the Democrats leak the news to the mainstream media. As a result of the tough fundraising environment Republicans are seeing across the nation, we're not raising enough money to run the campaign that we need to be running. That means we've had to make some hard decisions. We made the toughest call we've had to make since last August. We don't have enough money in the bank to keep our TV ads on air. As of last week, our ads are no longer running across Georgia. Meanwhile, our opponent Raphael Warnock has more cash than he knows what to do with. He has more than $22 million in the bank and is raising MILLIONS MORE each WEEK. While our campaign doesn't have the money to keep our ads running, Raphael Warnock could run ads for the next 10 weeks without raising another dollar. I need your help. The more money we raise today, the sooner we can get back on the air. It takes $2 million per week to run TV ads across Georgia. This might seem like a big number - and it is - I am counting on you, Fellow American. Thank you, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? He cares about himself and continuing his role as Joe Biden’s puppet here in the Sunshine State.

Since Brandon was elected to office, Charlie Crist has voted with him 100% of the time.

Peter, we don’t need to tell you Charlie Crist is bad for you, bad for your family, and bad for Florida.

Governor DeSantis is just getting started on his fight to keep Florida free.

| | | |
---
| Dear Friends,
Congratulations! We did it!
The Fair and Secure MA Committee announced today that about 100,000 people signed the petition to repeal legislation giving driver's licenses to illegal immigrants - almost twice the number needed.
After I called for this ballot question a few months ago, volunteers from the Diehl and Allen campaigns were vital in collecting tens of thousands of these signatures over the past few weeks. Without you and all we did together, this would not have happened.
---
---
Leah and I would like to thank you for all of your hard work.
No matter how hot it was sitting outside shopping malls, and no matter how hard those on the left tried to push back, you were there. You were there this year just like you were there back in 2014 when we fought to repeal inflationary gas tax increases. We collected 100,000 signatures for that question back then, and it passed at the ballot box. I am confident that we will have the same result this November.
It is vitally important that we see the process through until the end. We will be working hard to get the word out to more voters over the next few weeks, reminding them how important it is to vote.
That process starts in just a few days, with the Republican Primary on September 6. I respectfully ask you to please remember to get out and vote for Leah Allen and for me.
Today is cause for celebration, and for gratitude. Thank you for all you've done so far, and all you intend to do going forward.
Tell all your friends to get on-board and join us. We're going to win this. (Just don't tell the liberal elites; let them all be shocked when they find out on November 8!)
Sincerely,

The Fair and Secure MA Committee announced today that about 100,000 people signed the petition to repeal legislation giving driver's licenses to illegal immigrants - almost twice the number needed. After I called for this ballot question a few months ago, volunteers from the Diehl and Allen campaigns were vital in collecting tens of thousands of these signatures over the past few weeks. Without you and all we did together, this would not have happened. Leah and I would like to thank you for all of your hard work. No matter how hot it was sitting outside shopping malls, and no matter how hard those on the left tried to push back, you were there. You were there this year just like you were there back in 2014 when we fought to repeal inflationary gas tax increases. We collected 100,000 signatures for that question back then, and it passed at the ballot box. I am confident that we will have the same result this November. It is vitally important that we see the process through until the end. We will be working hard to get the word out to more voters over the next few weeks, reminding them how important it is to vote. That process starts in just a few days, with the Republican Primary on September 6. I respectfully ask you to please remember to get out and vote for Leah Allen and for me. Today is cause for celebration, and for gratitude. Thank you for all you've done so far, and all you intend to do going forward. Tell all your friends to get on-board and join us. She has a long history of advocating for those who are too often left behind and ignored. I will do everything possible to help her win this November. ** We’re up against a powerful Republican incumbent this election, and we have a lot of challenges to overcome. Some of those in the establishment have counted us out, and But Brenda’s a fighter. She’s overcome harder odds in the past. And I want to elect a fighter as our next Governor. Right now, our most important task is to improve and increase fundraising. The Republican Incumbent has a strong financial edge on us. We have a massive reporting deadline coming up on Monday, and we need significantly more funding and resources to win this race. This campaign is centered around our ideas, plans, and issue advocacy. We have less than a week until our fundraising deadline, and we’re still a long way from our goal. We need your help. We know that Max Miller has earned many labels: | |
---
Peter, There are less than 100 days until voting day in our election against Max Miller. Soon, the people of Ohio’s 7th district will decide who we want to represent us in Congress. **** We know that Max Miller has earned many labels: Trust fund baby: Max is worth up to 14.8 million dollars almost entirely due to his trust funds. He hasn't worked for most of his adult life. Insurrectionist: Max was subpoenaed by the January 6th committee for his role in planning events that day. body:
Parting Words to the Patriots

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/0f05d296076e/parting-words-from-melissa-martz?e=77bc5297c6)

** **See Video And Letter below***
------------------------------------------------------------
CLICK HERE: https://melissamartz.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4170e64cfef2b4eb82baf8e12&id=db7916ab44&e=77bc5297c6

Dear Patriots,

Words cannot express the gratitude and pride I have for all of you who have stood up to help us fight for the cause of Liberty and the preservation of our Republic. The support for our grassroots campaign, over this last year and a half has been massive. I was put on the ballot with well over 2600 signatures (many of which were turned in late and were not reflected in the final count). We have about 2000 LESS people come out tot vote in this primary than the last two primaries in this district. From our own informal polling, we were confident we winning on election day and were surprised by the result. However, I am not disheartened to have lost this race because in a true republic, it would still mean that the people won. It would mean the people chose their representative.

However, I do not believe we have free and fair election. I do not believe the numbers on voting day reflected the truth. I am concerned that the voting data is not accurate. I would like the people to know that I will do my due diligence to investigate the legitimacy of the votes reported in my race. I will continue to advocate and work for Election integrity.

We the people rule. We must not give up. We must keep standing in our sovereignty. Not just for ourselves but for our children. Thank you to those who vetted their candidates and voted. We must keep showing up and demanding accountability in our elections and from our representatives. I will never stop, standing, fighting, or speaking the truth.

I will be writing a book to detail ALL the corruption and censorship I have experienced in my race. It may surprise you to learn the sources. I will be bringing the receipts – so stay tuned and Stay Free!

In Liberty,

Melissa Martz, Esq.

Peter,

Folks, we just **won** the special election for New York’s 19th Congressional District! I am looking forward to representing the great people of this district, including my neighbors, my friends, and the community I call home. It is the honor of my life to bring your voices with me to Washington. All of the hard work and energy poured into this race has paid off. The incredible team of grassroots donors and volunteers who believed in us from the start made the difference in this competitive race. **I am so unbelievably grateful for the support you’ve given this campaign.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49687785/363137023/-1043373408?refcode=AU_PKR_CL_GEN_GEN_INau_20220824_PM3_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85OTAyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkY2ZmOTRiZS1mMDIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fNRxnYTW0QBZSXcGm2SuKRZbAfzNoEHJxT7tiGLFAxA=) We overcame so much to win this seat. Republican super PACs spent millions of dollars on ads attacking me. **We sent a strong message to the rest of the country today: voters aren’t going to back down from the fight to protect reproductive freedoms.** This election was about choice and protecting our personal freedoms, and just as we saw earlier this month in Kansas, ensuring reproductive rights are safe is top of mind for voters. Our campaign was also about passing gun safety legislation, about combating increasing costs and a worsening economy, about protecting our planet for future generations. **And voters made it clear: they want to see progress on these issues, not obstruction by Republicans.** Team, I am so proud of what we accomplished. We’re not taking any breaks though – we need to look towards the November election as well, when we’re on the ballot for a full term. **But for now, I want to say thank you. Peter, Growing up, Tina learned from her first-generation American parents the value of hard work, being active in the community, and following your dreams. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49688185/363138528/710531845?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220824_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjI0MWFjYi1mMTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JxRT8RWqG3XxGjumOzThIVWVAog-Yv0_E0SaHEoOSUE=) She arrived from the East Coast in 1987 and fell in love with the Oregon, ultimately completing her undergraduate degree at the University of Oregon. In her new home state, she found a place where she could truly be herself. Tina came out as a lesbian in her early twenties and learned through her journey that advocating for herself and others was necessary to undermine bigotry and realize a just world for everyone. This commitment inspired her efforts in graduate school to fight for and win domestic partnership rights for students and faculty at the University of Washington. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49688186/363138529/710531845?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220824_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjI0MWFjYi1mMTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JxRT8RWqG3XxGjumOzThIVWVAog-Yv0_E0SaHEoOSUE=) After graduate school, Tina returned to Oregon and joined the team at Oregon Food Bank. During her time there, she honed her skills as an advocate for others who have been overlooked and underserved. She continued her advocacy work as the policy director at Children First for Oregon (now Our Children Oregon), and this experience working with nonprofits on behalf of Oregon’s most vulnerable led her to run and serve in the Oregon Legislature. In 2013, Tina became the Oregon Speaker of the House. Through her leadership, the Oregon House passed progressive changes that expanded economic security for more families, combated climate change, and helped families in need during the pandemic. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49688187/363138530/710531845?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220824_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjI0MWFjYi1mMTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JxRT8RWqG3XxGjumOzThIVWVAog-Yv0_E0SaHEoOSUE=) Now Tina is running for Governor because she knows that Oregon needs a leader who’s ready to get to work on day one and knows that actions speak louder than words. [**So please, will you contribute to elect Tina Kotek so that she can continue to fight for the people and families of Oregon? Any amount makes a difference and gets us one step closer to electing a proven leader who prioritizes justice, equity, and bringing people together.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49688188/363138531/710531845?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220824_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjI0MWFjYi1mMTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JxRT8RWqG3XxGjumOzThIVWVAog-Yv0_E0SaHEoOSUE=) Thank you for being on our team. — Team Tina

clean_body: | Peter, Growing up, Tina learned from her first-generation American parents the value of hard work, being active in the community, and following your dreams. = She arrived from the East Coast in 1987 and fell in love with the Oregon, ultimately completing her undergraduate degree at the University of Oregon. In her new home state, she found a place where she could truly be herself. Tina came out as a lesbian in her early twenties and learned through her journey that advocating for herself and others was necessary to undermine bigotry and realize a just world for everyone. This commitment inspired her efforts in graduate school to fight for and win domestic partnership rights for students and faculty at the University of Washington. = After graduate school, Tina returned to Oregon and joined the team at Oregon Food Bank. During her time there, she honed her skills as an advocate for others who have been overlooked and underserved. She continued her advocacy work as the policy director at Children First for Oregon (now Our Children Oregon), and this experience working with nonprofits on behalf of Oregon’s most vulnerable led her to run and serve in the Oregon Legislature. In 2013, Tina became the Oregon Speaker of the House. Through her leadership, the Oregon House passed progressive changes that expanded economic security for more families, combated climate change, and helped families in need during the pandemic. = Now Tina is running for Governor because she knows that Oregon needs a leader who’s ready to get to work on day one and knows that actions speak louder than words. = Thank you for being on our team. — Team Tina Tina for Oregon PO Box 42307 Portland, OR 97242 | mailto:info@tinafororegon.com | | Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek

# Leadership matters: a year after the Afghanistan debacle
---
|
---
---
| | |
---|---
|
A year ago this month, President Joe Biden, acting on political impulse, suddenly removed U.S. troops from Afghanistan.
He did so against advice of senior military leadership on the ground and in Washington.
While the whole nation wanted to end our long war in Afghanistan, most leaders recognized that it was important to leave the country in a better state than we found it. Instead, our careless departure allowed Afghanistan to immediately fall back into the hands of the Taliban--the same terrorist regime that we fought for 20 years.
Worse, the hasty, ill-considered withdrawal operation left 12 Marines, one Navy sailor, and one Army soldier dead from an opportunistic terrorist attack at the Kabul Airport.
A drone strike later that month only compounded the errors. While it was intended to attack those who killed our troops, it instead caused civilian casualties, including children. A subsequent review found no fault with those executing the mission, a concerning example of an overall lack of accountability for this failure.
| | |
---|---
|
Further, Al-Qaeda, who headquartered in Afghanistan when they committed the 9/11 atrocities, have also returned to Afghanistan; we know this from the recent operation to kill one of its leaders, Ayam Mohammed Rabie al-Zawarhiri, in Kabul of all places.
The withdrawal was and continues to be a heartbreaking tragedy for our service members and veterans. To be clear, the decision to leave Afghanistan in this haphazard, insecure, imprudent manner is solely owned by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. And after the debacle, the Democrat Congress did almost nothing.
| | |
---|---
|
President Biden's decision has had direct and unfortunate consequences. Thousands of Americans and Afghan allies were left behind. The Taliban reinstituted their oppression of women. Billions of dollars' worth of sensitive U.S. equipment and dangerous weapons were abandoned to fall into the hands of our enemies.
Even more worrisome, events around the world since the debacle may have unfolded adversely due to bad actors' reaction to our perceived weakness and incompetence. Russia acted on its long-held desire to invade and occupy Ukraine. China has begun making louder claims towards taking Taiwan. North Korea has resumed a program of missile testing. Iran is likely in the midst of gaining nuclear weapons. While those events may not be solely a result of the Afghanistan withdrawal, President Biden's decision undoubtedly affected those governments' own decision making.
| | |
---|---
|
We must learn from these grave mistakes. Don't abandon your own citizens. Don't leave behind friends who helped you. Listen to the experts. Do what is best for America in the long-run, despite ideological commitments or political expediency. Maintain peace through strength and don't allow unforced errors to degrade perception of American resolve.
Leadership matters.
Our country deserves better leadership in the White House and better oversight from Congress.

Both have let us down. We owe it to our troops and allies to hold them accountable at the ballot box this fall.

He did so against advice of senior military leadership on the ground and in Washington. While the whole nation wanted to end our long war in Afghanistan, most leaders recognized that it was important to leave the country in a better state than we found it. Instead, our careless departure allowed Afghanistan to immediately fall back into the hands of the Taliban--the same terrorist regime that we fought for 20 years. Worse, the hasty, ill-considered withdrawal operation left 12 Marines, one Navy sailor, and one Army soldier dead from an opportunistic terrorist attack at the Kabul Airport. A drone strike later that month only compounded the errors. While it was intended to attack those who killed our troops, it instead caused civilian casualties, including children. A subsequent review found no fault with those executing the mission, a concerning example of an overall lack of accountability for this failure. | | | ---|--- | Further, Al-Qaeda, who headquartered in Afghanistan when they committed the 9/11 atrocities, have also returned to Afghanistan; we know this from the recent operation to kill one of its leaders, Ayam Mohammed Rabie al-Zawarhiri, in Kabul of all places. The withdrawal was and continues to be a heartbreaking tragedy for our service members and veterans. And after the debacle, the Democrat Congress did almost nothing. | | | ---|--- | President Biden's decision has had direct and unfortunate consequences. Friend,
Last night, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent –and Friend, it’s more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I’ve worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. _**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ddf009635da43549d8754e07e7a9d2d&_e=AyD8MNYRXx4_nKCIJdVz2Zvol5oCemYO0QsKPOYgAnh2U2qd4HECLbYgAZuuJ9PVs0SJHsy2EworY-7Wzi5r_8HzLzCH3grL_cZTHEiLhQK2A_wUoplZSqA6YPu9Lm_sMqceLdy9Xqovq-gxStk0v1Ss9uOzfpaqbZMBI-zYyAXfmsqELhUPL8X5LE3bbjcxFVBtoBvnJRatzORR3Pe1TaMTU4WAM58R80m7I2E9j7BfL5Mf6s9gvvfwquK6OtO1jvaXfj_RbXM4xMgKOO5HOHOB1KVcX_Cb406-nx0-r4zLdf-29eMTdKdnJAtJr9oJHArNFrTp1vp3v6blZw8jCA%3D%3D "Stand with me to protect our state. >>>>")**_

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that’s what this fight is all about. _**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ddf009635da43549d8754e07e7a9d2d&_e=AyD8MNYRXx4_nKCIJdVz2Zvol5oCemYO0QsKPOYgAnh2U2qd4HECLbYgAZuuJ9PVs0SJHsy2EworY-7Wzi5r_8HzLzCH3grL_cZTHEiLhQI6pxXf5Odki8lXxomFJHtAcDSbGbSZUOhAg94Md8POwLUmqInSvPuQAiPZS3PJ6BfOr8vqpccM-SxysFxl-TpV-NAUasGdlVdMJHWX_vBp3lYFJHJ2BjyI0b58gAr8XaiGr_afAIGhzSJPLezL8I8YdcAhM7fSX6r2gTnXb5elqXPLNxvCwEO9bvXY8XnOGbWkgNxWXbn7zBaohsUfBGA7zjjxSl1lHQoFwq5q1x9vuA%3D%3D "Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free. >>>>")**_

**It’s not about me, it’s not about my opponent, it’s about you – your business, your children’s education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left’s radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers’ unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children.

When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist – you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I’ve only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. _**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ddf009635da43549d8754e07e7a9d2d&_e=AyD8MNYRXx4_nKCIJdVz2Zvol5oCemYO0QsKPOYgAnh2U2qd4HECLbYgAZuuJ9PVs0SJHsy2EworY-7Wzi5r_8HzLzCH3grL_cZTHEiLhQIUHsdG3xpind2fSExl8kfvtHQT9elK1kb7QhGzdrcn3lDKgxJWHVV2j8GYLRfZLEIVyW4q9y3e-Yq58xj47IJQWSy_d0Fhh3UIUDiXwV8aIGOgYHiaeBmxJkyWn3E-5IYb_zetm2otFA36cQmWJAATfUP_Z-3_SefzAH05evLd5e0rFqRK1X_58o9m0pXSoFSZL6Z54Gm_2c5uF14nob8tQmxVNyAT7C_kjSW3Llxs7Q%3D%3D "Rush in your support TODAY. >>>>")**_

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business’ ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and _**[stand with me in the fight against the Left’s schemes and radical agenda.>>>>](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6ddf009635da43549d8754e07e7a9d2d&_e=AyD8MNYRXx4_nKCIJdVz2Zvol5oCemYO0QsKPOYgAnh2U2qd4HECLbYgAZuuJ9PVs0SJHsy2EworY-7Wzi5r_8HzLzCH3grL_cZTHEiLhQIyhLnCMchcbL8VyOXvcSbZ4NijFb7b0zMJmBwmSeLvo5FLrtSf-2ejpBRlpCaX6PX3SrAhET_1Tx3qCSqNxX-GtrPDJ9nQVKYj8GFSTGDQgIxoK59B1qwIToaTwxoGU8zD8LfTb0y3cfxPYmpvtUaFhoYgDgBvTPMqOfmZ1-C2DGPM-dii89oETahEJm_9rjn6O-x9In1nZ_b82YqR3OKbQcMhodKQKQM1w6p_RyTPNw%3D%3D "stand with me in the fight against the Left’s schemes and radical agenda. >>>>")**_

"Stand with me to protect our state. >>>>" As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done. In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that’s what this fight is all about. "Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free. >>>>" It’s not about me, it’s not about my opponent, it’s about you – your business, your children’s education, and your personal liberties. Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left’s radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it. When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week. When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side. When woke teachers’ unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist – you'll get the inside of a jail cell. I’ve only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. "Rush in your support TODAY. >>>>" This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business’ ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns. Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Al

body:
This week the Association of Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs endorsed Nathan Hochman for Attorney General. | | |
---
| | Dear Peter ,

Throughout this campaign, I have been proud to stand with law enforcement and advocate for increased resources and support for the men and women doing the hard work of keeping our communities safe each and every day. This week, I was pleased to have the Association of Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs join the campaign and endorse my candidacy for Attorney General.

Representing over 8,000 sworn officers, the Association of Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs is the largest single agency law enforcement union in the state.
---
|
---
|
Our current Attorney General has consistently taken an adversarial stance against law enforcement throughout his career. Rather than working collaboratively to solve our public safety challenges, Rob Bonta has only fanned the flames of divisiveness and caused increased community tension. As Attorney General, I will work together with partners in law enforcement to restore balance to our justice system.

I hope you will join the sworn officers of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department in supporting our campaign. Contributions can be made online by clicking the link below.

With gratitude,

Nathan

name: Jamal Raad, Evergreen Action
subject: How it started, how it's going
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
A letter from our executive director
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/3139?t=2&akid=13093%2E53494%2ENoOKZE) Friend, A little over two years ago, we launched Evergreen Action with a mission to create an all-out mobilization to defeat the climate crisis and accelerate the transition to a just and equitable economy run on 100% clean energy. Now we can celebrate a major milestone in that effort: the first significant climate legislation in U.S. history, with America's largest-ever investments in climate and clean energy. **The path to passing the Inflation Reduction Act was not easy.** It was daunting. At times it felt impossible. And now it is law. This extraordinary achievement was only possible because of the power built over decades of climate activism. **Every voter, volunteer, and activist in our movement helped get this bill across the finish line.** Evergreen followers made 6,377 calls, sent 47,517 letters, and contributed 131,678 signatures to help get this bill passed. At Evergreen, we were proud to play an important role in developing critical climate policy in the IRA, and moved by the outpouring of support from this community that helped get the bill across the finish line. The benefits of the bill are immense. **The IRA is a carbon-pollution-cutting, job-creating, inflation-fighting machine that will help America lead the world in the transition to the clean energy economy of the future.** It directs billions of dollars of investments to disadvantaged communities which will help to address decades of environmental racism that has forced Black, Brown, and Indigenous communities to bear the brunt of the impacts of deadly pollution and climate change. And by putting us on track to cut carbon pollution 40% below 2005 levels by 2030, this law will finally put America within striking distance of our climate targets and save countless lives. But even as we celebrate all that is good in this law, we must also acknowledge that it was a compromise, with real harms for front-line communities. Senator Joe Manchin demanded provisions that would mandate oil and gas lease sales in the Gulf of Mexico and Alaska's Cook Inlet, and would tie clean energy development on our public lands to further oil and gas leasing. But this fight is not over, and we plan to pull out all the stops to deliver big, bold climate action in the days ahead. **That starts with our effort to kill Manchin's sidecar scheme. We will fight any effort to cut communities out of the permitting process, fast-track fossil fuel pipelines, or attack America's bedrock environmental laws.** And it will continue with our ongoing work over the coming years to ensure that every cent of the $370 billion for climate in the IRA is spent in a way that helps us secure the equitable clean energy future we deserve. We are going to keep the pressure on President Biden to deploy every executive authority at his disposal in the fight against climate change, and give governors and state leaders the policy roadmap to raise the bar for climate action in the states. The investments in the IRA will make our movement and the clean energy industry stronger for the tasks ahead, and we intend to keep fighting like hell for our future. I am proud to be in this fight alongside passionate people committed to building a better future for us all. Thank you for your support. Onward. Jamal Raad
Executive Director, Evergreen Action

Time and again, our campaign defied expectations and predictions, but we wouldn't have gone anywhere without folks like you who volunteered, came to events, donated, hosted parties, and spread the word about our movement. This election is one of the most important in the country, and we're just as committed to fighting for Long Islanders as we've ever been. ---
| | | John Fetterman doesn’t look like your typical senate candidate – [nearly 7 feet tall, with tattoos running down his arms](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6f74fe61-94dd-45bf-a883-a654c53e8354/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), and one of the coolest beards in politics. And that might be part of the reason that voters love him, and why he’s beating Dr. Oz in the polls, and could flip Pennsylvania’s Senate seat from Republican to Democrat. But Dr. Oz is loaded (ten houses!), and is going to use it to fight back hard and dirty, and we need to make sure Fetterman’s lead doesn’t disappear. [Chip in anything you can to John Fetterman’s campaign so we can save our Senate majority >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5dbb8073-5d8b-4258-a6a1-6b3431fd46cf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | John Fetterman is the real deal – he doesn’t look or act like your typical politician, he just puts working people first and fights for issues that affect us all. And he does it with a sense of humor. And as lieutenant governor, he has already won state-wide, and can do it again. Dr. Oz. on the other hand, is a Trump-loving charlatan who can’t even remember how many houses he owns. And just this week, [he mocked John for suffering a stroke!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T672903c1-093f-414a-927c-84cd2b192d51/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) He’s absolutely vile and we’ve had enough of his BS. But Trump is heading to Pennsylvania next week for a rally to try to save Dr. Oz’s sinking campaign. We can’t let him gain any momentum! We must make sure John holds a steady lead over Oz so we can flip this seat. | | Hi there, Earlier this week, our team asked this community to share their first memories of voting — we wanted to share a few of the submissions with you today: **From Deborah P. in Oregon:** “I graduated from high school in June of 1971. When the amendment was passed for 18 to become the voting age I was so excited! I turned 18 on December 3rd, 1971. My New Year’s resolution was to register to vote. When I went back to my college after Christmas break they were helping people to register, it was my first 1972 New Year’s resolution that I fulfilled.” **From Darryll P. in Texas:** “My first memory was as a young child holding my mother’s hand, following my step-dad to the school to vote. The walkway up to the school was lined with angry white people holding bats, sticks and shotguns cursing with every breath. I asked my Mom if we did something wrong. The wrong was taking part in democracy and voting. I’ve never missed one for the past 48 years and never will as long as breath is in my body.” **From James U. in Minnesota:** “My first election was the Kansas Primary Election in August 1972. I had turned 18 just five weeks prior to the election and was very excited to vote. 1972 was the first election after 18-year-olds were given the right to vote nationwide. I volunteered to be a precinct poll worker, and as a young new voter, I was readily accepted to be part of the team...It was a long, often boring day but I was proud to play an important small part in the most important civic duty we all have.” It is so moving to read your stories and see just how much of an impact we can make on our communities when we make our voices heard at the polls. But we need to make it possible for more young people to have positive, empowering early voting experiences — and that means continuing to push back against attempts to suppress the vote. Fair Fight Action won’t stop working until every eligible voter can experience free, fair, and secure elections. clean_body: Earlier this week, our team asked this community to share their first memories of voting — we wanted to share a few of the submissions with you today: Fair Fight | | | Hi there, Earlier this week, our team asked this community to share their first memories of voting — we wanted to share a few of the submissions with you today: From Deborah P. in Oregon: “I graduated from high school in June of 1971. When the amendment was passed for 18 to become the voting age I was so excited! I turned 18 on December 3rd, 1971. My New Year’s resolution was to register to vote. When I went back to my college after Christmas break they were helping people to register, it was my first 1972 New Year’s resolution that I fulfilled.” From Darryll P. in Texas: “My first memory was as a young child holding my mother’s hand, following my step-dad to the school to vote. The walkway up to the school was lined with angry white people holding bats, sticks and shotguns cursing with every breath. I asked my Mom if we did something wrong. The wrong was taking part in democracy and voting. I’ve never missed one for the past 48 years and never will as long as breath is in my body.” From James U. in Minnesota: “My first election was the Kansas Primary Election in August 1972. I had turned 18 just five weeks prior to the election and was very excited to vote. 1972 was the first election after 18-year-olds were given the right to vote nationwide. I volunteered to be a precinct poll worker, and as a young new voter, I was readily accepted to be part of the team...It was a long, often boring day but I was proud to play an important small part in the most important civic duty we all have.” It is so moving to read your stories and see just how much of an impact we can make on our communities when we make our voices heard at the polls. But we need to make it possible for more young people to have positive, empowering early voting experiences — and that means continuing to push back against attempts to suppress the vote. Fair Fight Action won’t stop working until every eligible voter can experience free, fair, and secure elections. But we can’t accomplish this without the support of people like you — = | = Thank you for everything, The Fair Fight Action team | 1270 Caroline Street Suite D120-430 Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2022 Fair Fight Action - All rights reserved. A brand new public poll shows our race in an EXACT TIE.

In a bellwether district with a clear contrast and abortion rights on the line, voters made absolutely clear last night that we will not allow Republicans to roll back our fundamental rights and freedoms.
Just like what happened in Kansas, this is just another indication that in places where national talking heads think we can’t win, voters are showing up to fight for our constitutional rights.

Peter,

Washington DC is called _"the swamp"_ for a reason.

It is filled to the brim with career politicians who prioritize fame and fortune over service to their constituents – **people who sellout to the establishment for their own benefit!**

Peter,

I had hoped it wouldn't come to this, **but I'd prefer to be the one to tell you rather than let the Democrats leak the news to the mainstream media.**

As a result of the tough fundraising environment Republicans are seeing across the nation, **we're not raising enough money to run the campaign that we need to be running.** That means we've had to make some hard decisions. We made the toughest call we've had to make since last August.

We don't have enough money in the bank to keep our TV ads on air. As of last week, our ads are no longer running across Georgia.

Peter: This is a long but important message about defending our fundamental rights from far-right extremism. It would mean a lot to me if you read until the very end.
The New Mexico GOP is out of control, Peter. My opponent has been campaigning with Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis – the Trump-wannabe Governor of Florida who signed the "Don't Say Gay" bill into law, started a petty war with Disney, and literally called for imprisoning Dr. Fauci for keeping Americans safe from COVID-19.
**Make no mistake: This pair of extremists doesn't represent us here in New Mexico. We are a resilient state full of kind and hardworking people who want the best for their families – and we will not let the GOP import hatred and toxicity. **
**[As the GOP continues to spread lies and smear my reputation in an attempt to win over voters, I need your urgent support to raise $150,000 before the end of the month to set the record straight. Can I count on you to donate $5 or more to keep New Mexico blue, Peter? ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49699183/363150456/-1540418300?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1430-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OGQ1NWE2MS1mZTIzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SUChrS3WJJRqTcsnZYzSEMKEYwtYUKV_BgMrmyfNKNw=)**
I wish I could say I was surprised that my opponent took the stage with Ron DeSantis, Peter, but I have known from the day my opponent launched his campaign that his true intentions are to take social progress all the way back to the 1950s.
Recently, my opponent refused to condemn the Proud Boys, a white supremacist group that attacked the U.S. Capitol on Jan. 6. Worse yet, he has also secretly promised his influential supporters and megachurch pastors that he would ban abortion if he were elected.
**The worst part is, I'm neck and neck in the polls with this GOP extremist. My Trump-style opponent would be a disaster for New Mexico and for the progress Democrats have made nationally – so I'm counting on you to help me reach my $150,000 goal before the end of the month:**

The lawsuit was filed against the superintendent of the Minneapolis Public Schools, the Minneapolis Public Schools, and the Minneapolis Board of Education for violating the Equal Protection Guarantee of the Minnesota Constitution.

| | As you might have already heard, Congress just passed historic legislation to tackle the climate crisis, transition America to clean energy sources and lower prescription prices for seniors. But there's more. **I'm happy to report that the**** _Inflation Reduction Act_****includes my bill to****crack down on corporate stock buybacks and ensure companies invest in their workers – not their shareholders.** During the pandemic, corporate stock buybacks – which is corporate speak for giving a payout to your shareholders – reached an all-time high. While American families were making hard decisions about paying rent and putting food on the table, mega-corporations were jacking up their prices of goods and then used their massive profits to buy back shares of their own stock and line the pockets of their executives and wealthy investors. **This greed is morally repugnant. And it's still happening.** As Americans were struggling to afford the high cost of gas at the pump, Exxon Mobil just announced its biggest quarterly profit _ever_ , then turned around and spent _billions_ on stock buybacks. By taxing these corporate stock buybacks, my plan not only ensures these major corporations pay their fair share in taxes, it incentivizes them to invest in their workers instead It's time for corporate accountability. That means mega-corporations must start paying their fair share and prioritizing their workers, not wealthy investors and shareholders. This is a huge win in the fight for equality. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
This is a racial justice, gender justice, and economic justice issue.
#
Peter,
President Biden just announced that he will cancel $10,000 - $20,000 of student loan debt for folks making less than $125K a year. He also extended the pause on student loan payments through the end of the year.
Canceling student loan debt will give financial relief to 45 million Americans, jumpstart our economy, and create a million jobs. It’s an economic, gender, and racial justice issue. **President Biden’s executive action is a major step in the right direction, but it’s not enough.**
Student loan debt disproportionately impacts Black and brown folks. Women hold nearly 2/3 of the trillions in student debt. 1 out of every 5 people that carry crushing loan debt are over 50 years old. If we’re serious about alleviating the economic weight of student debt on so many Americans, the answer is canceling every dollar of student loan debt.
[**Pramila will continue her fight to cancel ALL student loan debt. Are you with her? Chip in $3 to fuel the work today, so Pramila can continue the fight for the people, for a better future for all, and for economic, social, and racial justice in America.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16179?refcode=em20220824-1544&t=1&akid=1544%2E420207%2E_keWaS)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16179?refcode=em20220824-1544&t=20&akid=1544%2E420207%2E_keWaS)**
The President’s decision will give $20,000 of relief to Pell grant recipients and $10,000 to others — for folks who meet the income thresholds. It will also cap loan payments at 5% of monthly income. It’s a big deal, and we’re grateful the President is using his power after the Congressional Progressive Caucus advocated for student debt cancellation.
But we must remember this decision will not end the burden of student loan debt for millions of people.
We know canceling student loan debt will help the economy. We know it will provide hope to people across this country. We know it is the right thing to do. And it's something that is universally popular, not just with Democrats, but with independents and Republicans.
[**Fuel Pramila’s fight to cancel every penny of student loan debt today with a donation of $3 or anything at all. We can go even bigger for the people.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16179?refcode=em20220824-1544&t=21&akid=1544%2E420207%2E_keWaS)
We can, and must, get this done.
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220824-1544-footer&t=22&refcode2=1544_420207__keWaS&akid=1544%2E420207%2E_keWaS)**

body:
Friend- As we remember the destruction and chaos that ensued in Kenosha in 2020, it’s impossible to forget the way Mandela Barnes put his own political interests **FIRST** and Wisconsin **LAST**. As Kenosha burned, Mandela Barnes refused to step up and be a **LEADER** for Wisconsin. **_Instead, he jumped to conclusions and threw law enforcement under the bus._** In response to the shooting of Jacob Blake, which an independent report found to be [justified](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=OhlATZ-QoebODN39iuw6LrnjRsQjvhbTWmA4IyWYGcI1J3cR7ok70XUmEztlmPrlLB-p5Uko10a80oTZ-Y6Rx9mmcRwG3szvKMNiFH0FBcjzkNtsgiBJHBGh1voGzd13R93dSEv2nru4YwHeuF3a6Q&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_barnes_v1&n=1), Mandela Barnes tweeted: [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVXhNNHMHBnyndWI4mg8yGSUlynoWq_sx0wzLOPYWc2Vk&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_barnes_v1&n=2) After businesses and the livelihoods of countless Kenoshans were burned to the ground, unbelievably, Mandela Barnes claimed that from the riots you could see a “community” being built in the “wake of it all.” Friend, Mandela Barnes is as radical as they come. **He used turmoil and mayhem in Kenosha to appeal to the woke, radical left while abandoning Kenoshans and law enforcement in the process.** [**_We must hold him accountable. We can’t let him win this November. Will you help us NOW?!_**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVXhNNHMHBnyndWI4mg8yGSUlynoWq_sx0wzLOPYWc2Vk&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_barnes_v1&n=3) | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVXhNNHMHBnyndWI4mg8yGSUlynoWq_sx0wzLOPYWc2Vk&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_barnes_v1&n=4 "CONTRIBUTE") [CONTRIBUTE](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVXhNNHMHBnyndWI4mg8yGSUlynoWq_sx0wzLOPYWc2Vk&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kenosha_barnes_v1&n=4)

body:
I’m glad to have you by my side, Fellow American, but our work is not done yet. |
[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=9ae6e35971f544629bee48e08450897e&_e=2ZPldmf2ySyuWY4jMjDRN1G31397rZMbdaTxBN9_XPGwbcq33SVTtomxLDfct6Gcn0JIF2UWFiY2eBkfLrK7NTLh9nO11yeOxH5TrRoY8IRimj32YjkIhUmKBLlXoWJbPb7YbeXMnotETd_D4YWpDLWsZnAXQ1qW1VUoVfXQQSCG_g-LZ1pcv5S_Um2sdbl2TiBiQqcyQhbJvdILQY8rG3k0qlg_qFipENhHIdQNpfJ5gcl_bP4Cs1thmKe0LwQKJuI5jfzsJ7kUCgiwT2d34aVp1woyx5X-inxdWVRuQusjqwkELwcONvpYtvjUeyOSqC0CkU2fZb-jWm_YcUkN3okWzeWklgZkRt1kFAFGPZGrUnQDMeWOUp5O1nBKoA0_kqaIJcR6y_Oz_UtFSa6wcxyfD_I5DSDFvpc9348X_2I%3D)

---
Fellow American,

One year ago, we officially launched our campaign for the United States Senate.

We've put in 365 days of HARD WORK. We've put thousands of miles on the Team Herschel truck, spent time listening to the people of Georgia, and made many new friends along the way.

Fellow American, I am incredibly proud of our team - Team Herschel.

_I am just a kid from the small town of Wrightsville, Georgia, who has been blessed to experience the American Dream. Now I want to make sure every Georgian, and every American, has that same opportunity._

**[As we celebrate the one-year milestone of this campaign today, can I count on your support again?](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=9ae6e35971f544629bee48e08450897e&_e=2ZPldmf2ySyuWY4jMjDRN1G31397rZMbdaTxBN9_XPGwbcq33SVTtomxLDfct6Gcn0JIF2UWFiY2eBkfLrK7NTLh9nO11yeOxH5TrRoY8IRimj32YjkIhUmKBLlXoWJbPb7YbeXMnotETd_D4YWpDLWsZnAXQ1qW1VUoVfXQQSCG_g-LZ1pcv5S_Um2sdbl2TiBiQqcyQhbJvdILQY8rG3k0qlg_qFipENhHIdQNpfJ5gcl_bP4Cs1thmKe0LwQKK-ce7jGiTg1J1IFGdBF7No1rF-5RZ6RyB65-Qka3npzEkX6OdKxtXnEaItvx1xhHcfwqsdQzzxjbNO9yso35Hgkqux8XkkQFkNrwwDUSKziTcxLBRzbRolTnsdtzi6kfm7Mwk957K8kmuSdqFtyonRjN4vdqXNRIe4w2cknqYos%3D)**

I got in this race because we cannot afford six years of Senator Raphael Warnock and his support of the disastrous Biden agenda. America is going down the wrong track, and we've got to turn our country around before it's too late.

This race is too important to sit on the sidelines. That's just one of the reasons I decided to run for the U.S. Senate. **Georgians deserve better._America deserves better._**

Raphael Warnock's campaign is breaking records. _He has raised over $64 million and has $22 million still left for the final weeks of this race._

**Senator Warnock is going to set new records for _dollars raised AND spent_ in a Senate campaign.**
His campaign and liberal Super PACs have been coming after me, too. _They've already spent $25 million attacking my character with downright NASTY and FALSE ads._

**But here's the good news, Fellow American: even though he's been raising and spending more than any other candidate in the country, this race is still tied.**

During my football career, I took hard hits, got knocked down, and experienced a lot of cheap shots. But I always got back up, and I never quit.

Politics is no different. No matter how cheap the shots are or how nasty the attacks get, I'm not giving up because America is worth fighting for.

body:
Peter,

I am honored and humbled to have secured the Democratic nomination for Congress in New York’s 10th Congressional District.

Together we will work towards our shared vision for New York, to improve the lives of so many in this city and this country who don’t have access to the opportunities that every American deserves. I promise to be a champion and advocate for healthcare for all, LGBTQ rights, better education, more affordable housing, and a more humane and compassionate immigration system.

This victory is also a rebuke of Donald Trump. We will not let authoritarian forces undermine the foundations of our democracy and the rule of law.

The stakes could not be higher in the upcoming election in November — everything is on the ballot: the right to choose, the right to vote, our safety, our planet — and our democracy itself. We all must do everything we can to hold the House and Senate in November to preserve our democracy and ensure a functioning government.

I am deeply grateful for the trust you've placed in me to serve as your representative to Congress. I promise I will fight for you, our city and our country every single day.

Sincerely,
Dan Goldman

body:
It’s critical we raise resources now. | | | Peter, Last night, WFP candidates in New York and Florida faced off in a number of closely watched Democratic primaries. Here are some of the results: **In Florida, Maxwell Frost won his primary in Florida’s 10th Congressional district!** He is the 8th WFP-endorsed, non-incumbent Congressional candidate to win his primary this election cycle. And if he goes on to win this seat (which is expected in this heavily-Democratic district), he would be the first Gen Z member of Congress. **In New York, WFP candidates for Congress and State Senate had a huge night up and down the ballot.** Squad member Rep. Jamaal Bowman won his primary in the newly-drawn NY-16 against an opponent backed by the incumbent he ousted in 2020 and a ton of outside money. WFP-endorsed Rep. Jerry Nadler won his primary in the new NY-12. And in the face of a flood of outside spending from real estate and billionaires, **we expanded our progressive bloc in the State Senate.** These candidates — some incumbents and some new challengers including long-time organizers — will represent working families and continue to push for much-needed change. Together, we have once again shown what’s possible when we come together to fight for each other. And with 75 days to go until Election Day, now is no time to let up. **[If we’re going to elect all of these people’s champions in November, we need to ramp up our resources for the General Election now. Please make a donation of $8 today to support our slate of progressive candidates across the country.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUvzdQXYzAD5FXP8i-50QqRpbBNeObbHdIErshFbeUay4i06EkkSoudAmdbBpL7vbfhoSYDvS0Jk5fWb2wC5ud74_khqckOa06BYy1jZxmmkqStht9ARcMyAwpd09pD6vBz1_7mr0TEET2S9kSmO7M09aJPU-hzSlZERm0rS7MHKZo_eRXNNPjYnHhDJZvlzThdjVJpSJUYmI0blDGyoohllJcV4bnJZVbdfeLO46ko7oeNOKDXsn4Fd1ZKlwfjf5ksDLRzsiAhdSfhEJuMZKbyF2vlj5dCVeoeUukpb0VGExnvG87IQOakuZ751BpqO9Ey401-mkD8TD69KcpamSX24vqJ3e2a_DvV_RzubcTdmqiToXYnVA3JAjg7Z-jRmTX/3ov/EgtZ11GvSDO9rbGIiT26zA/h0/v29I5lOaeW3uprgY99ksffUzoNlVJKj8OzZCO-txi-w)** **[Donate $8 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYU1l6g4aP0P-rBpr2Q7ZSt4c7cQkfFj9l6wc7qBthg2S6wKwhqAVZ0HMEKhZ31fqOA6Rbx-e3XdnY0ajTmBrzbJHX1EOBUM_3c7-W1SleUv3jpp89qHyhbm23TlqS7qd9FHDHV_w_ynxfHPKmL3FpmUYiIgB_2V1A5PNKYLyYEP6xOmYij7kJpqHR6JqFjf8Ht19tY_bNUTCGrtT0oobBQ1J0otQIW2jRhVu66IyIdGqzh26m2zC-ZM7ihmLS1XYf3KPctWZilB3dO8FDao8Ord-Uz_ivSzRMDpKtxb0KiihQxmydG-o19qKVz85u6fRBZZBJ8jkMhV-Vv2T-3q9QOXEtoLT5d_FhI38AQh8bUzdDhSsHH-xLgTh4Oc0bDFmU1brSEAEQsebFV19zkPSrOpg/3ov/EgtZ11GvSDO9rbGIiT26zA/h1/ujdi_ZTcuV-84v8_Tel_rTRtSB-PEnVsCW56snefG_0)** In New York’s 10th Congressional district primary, we saw once again how hard it can be to compete against millionaires and outside attacks. At the last minute, AIPAC’s super PAC admitted to dumping almost half a million into dark money, anonymous attacks against WFP champion Yuh-Line Niou. All while, her opponent Dan Goldman — an heir to the Levi Strauss fortune worth over $250 million himself — dumped $5 million of his own money into this race. **Despite all of this, Yuh-Line still ended election night _just a few hundred votes short._** Even though this year’s Democratic primaries have seen an unprecedented avalanche of right wing and corporate Super PAC spending, we’ve also seen that progressives can get outspent and still win. clean_body: It’s critical we raise resources now. | | | Peter, Last night, WFP candidates in New York and Florida faced off in a number of closely watched Democratic primaries. Here are some of the results: In Florida, Maxwell Frost won his primary in Florida’s 10th Congressional district! He is the 8th WFP-endorsed, non-incumbent Congressional candidate to win his primary this election cycle. And if he goes on to win this seat (which is expected in this heavily-Democratic district), he would be the first Gen Z member of Congress. In New York, WFP candidates for Congress and State Senate had a huge night up and down the ballot. Squad member Rep. Jamaal Bowman won his primary in the newly-drawn NY-16 against an opponent backed by the incumbent he ousted in 2020 and a ton of outside money. WFP-endorsed Rep. Jerry Nadler won his primary in the new NY-12. And in the face of a flood of outside spending from real estate and billionaires, we expanded our progressive bloc in the State Senate. These candidates — some incumbents and some new challengers including long-time organizers — will represent working families and continue to push for much-needed change. Together, we have once again shown what’s possible when we come together to fight for each other. And with 75 days to go until Election Day, now is no time to let up. In New York’s 10th Congressional district primary, we saw once again how hard it can be to compete against millionaires and outside attacks. At the last minute, AIPAC’s super PAC admitted to dumping almost half a million into dark money, anonymous attacks against WFP champion Yuh-Line Niou. All while, her opponent Dan Goldman — an heir to the Levi Strauss fortune worth over $250 million himself — dumped $5 million of his own money into this race. Despite all of this, Yuh-Line still ended election night just a few hundred votes short. Even though this year’s Democratic primaries have seen an unprecedented avalanche of right wing and corporate Super PAC spending, we’ve also seen that progressives can get outspent and still win. But it’s one thing to be outspent 2-1 and something else entirely to get outspent 5-1 or 10-1. This kind of lopsided resource advantage is hard for anyone to overcome. And with just over two months to go until November, we can fully expect that even more millions will be spent by shady super PACs to try and drown out the voices of our grassroots candidates. Yet over the years, fewer Americans have been able to reap the benefits of our education system for one common reason: student loan debt. Higher education has become too expensive, and Democrats have made it a priority to change that. Thankfully, Americans can start to see the reflections of their work.

Today, President Joe Biden unveiled a new plan to alleviate the pressure on student loan borrowers. **This initiative forgives up to $10,000 for those making under $125,000 and gives an additional $10,000 in relief for federal Pell Grant recipients. Those with undergraduate loans will be able to cap repayment at 5% of their monthly income.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49702054/363173388/-199967388?refcode=EM_P_220824StudentLoanPetition_P_TEAM_90DO_7_NG_TESTB_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDBkMDA3MC0wZTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b1ivTux_Citb4nCVTyr_B_dNFT7DZWLDIxv64Lqk5uE=&emci=9e1e7b69-0e24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a40d0070-0e24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=11913588) **[To help celebrate today's big announcement, we've created a card just for President Biden and Democrats, thanking them for their incredible work. For many, the financial burden can weigh heavily on their households, making it difficult to afford other necessities like health insurance.

Forgiving student debt is a major step toward making education more accessible, and we are so excited to see this come to fruition. While the journey to debt-free education remains ongoing, we are ecstatic about the effects this will have on American families across the country and here in Delaware. **[Biden's latest initiative will help millions of borrowers struggling to pay for their education. We couldn't be more thrilled to have an administration who is getting to work to help our students reach their full potential, and we know you are, too! Will you join us today and sign our card thanking President Biden and Democrats for their incredible work?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49702057/363173391/-199967388?refcode=EM_P_220824StudentLoanPetition_P_TEAM_90DO_7_NG_TESTBL2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDBkMDA3MC0wZTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b1ivTux_Citb4nCVTyr_B_dNFT7DZWLDIxv64Lqk5uE=&emci=9e1e7b69-0e24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a40d0070-0e24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=11913588)** [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49702058/363173392/-199967388?refcode=EM_P_220824StudentLoanPetition_P_TEAM_90DO_7_NG_TESTB_B2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDBkMDA3MC0wZTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b1ivTux_Citb4nCVTyr_B_dNFT7DZWLDIxv64Lqk5uE=&emci=9e1e7b69-0e24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a40d0070-0e24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=11913588)

clean_body: In a historic move by President Biden, millions of Americans will see major student loan relief. Higher education has long been regarded as the “Great Equalizer.” Increasing access to the American dream, education helps our citizens reach their full potential through critical career development and financial growth. Yet over the years, fewer Americans have been able to reap the benefits of our education system for one common reason: student loan debt. Higher education has become too expensive, and Democrats have made it a priority to change that. Thankfully, Americans can start to see the reflections of their work. Today, President Joe Biden unveiled a new plan to alleviate the pressure on student loan borrowers. This initiative forgives up to $10,000 for those making under $125,000 and gives an additional $10,000 in relief for federal Pell Grant recipients. Those with undergraduate loans will be able to cap repayment at 5% of their monthly income. One in every five Americans has student loan debt. For many, the financial burden can weigh heavily on their households, making it difficult to afford other necessities like health insurance. Forgiving student debt is a major step toward making education more accessible, and we are so excited to see this come to fruition. While the journey to debt-free education remains ongoing, we are ecstatic about the effects this will have on American families across the country and here in Delaware. | | | Thank You For Your Love and Support Over the Last 13 Months

Hello Friend,

Unfortunately last night’s results were not what we expected and not what we felt going into the final days of the primary. We certainly wish we had prevailed, but Team Makki has much to be proud of.

First let me say, I'm so proud of my army of volunteers and the incredible leadership of my Campaign Manager Skylar Alexander. We ran a positive race and kept it about the people of Pinellas County and our collective desire to get our country back on track. We knocked over 20,000 doors and made this race about you, our neighbors, our children and our grandchildren's future. We will never stop fighting to ensure a better life for future generations of Americans.

I’m grateful to the 13 Pinellas County mayors who believed in me and my ability to best serve them in Washington. I am also grateful to Beverly Young, the widow of the late Congressman Bill Young, who backed me to help continue the legacy of her husband who did so much for our veterans.

I'm humbled and honored for each and every vote I received, and each and every minute of personal and financial support. I will always be eternally grateful for the opportunity.

All my best,
Amanda

You probably didn't start your day thinking you'd make a donation to my campaign. But that's what I need to ask you to do.
#
Peter -
I never thought it would go this way.
My mom was a Milwaukee school teacher for 30 years and my dad worked 3rd shift at the General Motors plant.
I never thought I’d become a state representative or Wisconsin’s first Black lieutenant governor. But my parents taught me to never settle for what is – we must reach for what can be.
I never thought I’d be running for U.S. Senate with control of the chamber at stake and so many important issues on the line.
I never thought tens of thousands of people would contribute and volunteer to be a part of this campaign after I decided to run.
And I never thought I’d have to ask supporters to do even more in order to help send Ron Johnson packing.
But that’s what I have to do today. I have to ask you to do more.
Ron Johnson has his special-interest donors and right-wing super PACs that will stop at nothing to protect this seat.
I know you probably didn’t start your day thinking you’d make a donation to my campaign, but that’s what I have to ask you to do if we’re going to flip this seat and beat Ron Johnson.
So please:
**[Can you split a $5 contribution to Patty Murray’s campaign and my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin today? I know that we can flip this seat in November – as long as we're in this together.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49702364/363187493/-1854470431?refcode=pm_em_220824_2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDc4NTUwYy0xNTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JSu36CtBKzDVmipPhoB91Pz0X8-dueIaf9GFx1qWWXA=)**

But all of us need to stay involved between now and the election to keep up our momentum and organize all across the state.
That's why your contribution today is so important. Thank you for chipping in, if you can afford it.
All my best,
Mandela

Dear Friend,
I’ve promised to be a governor who will have the back of organized labor in this state, and that’s why I am so honored to earn the endorsement of the Tennessee AFL-CIO.
Organized labor and unions are not only essential to protecting the voice of workers, but they create benefits for all of us. This year’s election will determine the future of labor in Tennessee, and we simply cannot afford to let radical politicians take away workers’ bargaining power in favor of wealthy executives and special interest groups.
This November, Amendment 1 is on the ballot. This would add Tennessee's "Right to Work" law to the state's constitution. We must send a clear message that workers deserve real rights and real freedom. So on our ballots, we must mark Jason Martin for Governor and NO on Amendment 1.
More than ever, Tennessee needs a governor who will stand up for workers by allowing them a seat at the table, and that’s the kind of governor I am prepared to be.
To reach this goal will take a collective effort, and I’m relying on your support to help this campaign stand up for organized labor in Tennessee. Can you make a contribution to help us give a voice to workers this November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/primarywintn]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/primarywintn]
Thank you for your support, as always.
