body:
Utah is not the safe Red State it used to be.
Democrats are SURGING and if I came up short it’s likely they could WIN the majority this fall. This is an all hands-on deck moment for conservatives across the country. Please, if you want to PROTECT our way of life – donate RIGHT NOW!
[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=0cdd5fd315a14aeb926db333e3f2b125&_e=grx7uYrMDRCcduJywByKBD0ZUmgORmGUuhcU9mPvLbKFK_gNE_NQOjevrfiIOUtne7Thh3kE9-POcDZH4lzTd56iOZ6JSAOI55N9-p8WbsahRmMEqEH74WwPn89hzTmc8fOD3w9quGeFzDnaJiU5enskQCelQNxkEqR6p5lw76l_84ij-mcXQWSR-5dMzFMEf-0BkbSPAA9ePOEtpwECQrpBveHjkwyAy8WDD2TtRjLiuuGD0CV8BewWjpp4tLFxIYmcBAQTrtvSTPeeqyNjZNuQLIknt-hcQY5PuEjllKYSDMl3K-bMcUlqW-l4SrT7QtUcTBjtGhJ7BC3ei-9FFFNExeOkMMka6TC_SgJ2V7qPQBbUCzd5k0z9p8Fv4kUPxrwULXvvzoYPYMbimbTHVg%3D%3D) | | Fellow American,

Utah is not the safe Red State it used to be.

With an influx of new voters from Blue States like California, **Democrats are now starting to fantasize about Utah turning into a battleground state.**

And if my Democrat-endorsed opponent were to win this Senate seat in November, that could be the beginning of the end.

body:
**[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b4af40e1112648938ba3bd7b6a4521be&_e=ZAoFoqvZneQYz5p7Tu4U8wUb-gd8JcMSlIXsZbbjXtZRx48SoK9a6OhZ_jf2IU17ko2Jn6BjtWqZW0UCn7oZqBXHxggS9qKLvg9uarddAwNpazYQRvQPLo7-jf5MBUswVbQN8D8CDtS-Ou5R6tlC-o4fuVCcQ24Qy7rHxELPhu-vEVON0S0AEDx0Qd-g5iamZAAzy9GYNh9osNLhbMAIdd5ia06qzfhdObmpfhrXvq40N2L6V8nDceSB1ZeBlABEFecCVMae-OvlVQcSCCEb2NDqtgFxVvcoUbivG0d0e6EG6J9dS7sbavxpXGNU6s8kuZSfTWPvbI8iyWPX2YPUnw%3D%3D)**

Peter,
Last night, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent and it's more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I've worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. __**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b4af40e1112648938ba3bd7b6a4521be&_e=ZAoFoqvZneQYz5p7Tu4U8wUb-gd8JcMSlIXsZbbjXtZRx48SoK9a6OhZ_jf2IU17ko2Jn6BjtWqZW0UCn7oZqBXHxggS9qKLvg9uarddAwNpazYQRvQPLo7-jf5MBUswVbQN8D8CDtS-Ou5R6tlC-o4fuVCcQ24Qy7rHxELPhu-vEVON0S0AEDx0Qd-g5iamS5yZJyncKGtorrl2otjmeX25MtPSNI_Yj3ehrkG3r11YUuT5e8Cyn9S4qb_LNiXOrhLwvNUgPhwsQfGnzj8msudoOTYD7zgzhv5WbtXx1_a9RDVy0JbFu8U--8crVgHIhwHvWhOK3jaFOkeS7_J5Tw%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a823e7f923b4e189ce24f81919f34ad5e6e0e93c92f5af7be0bc4983968cedf67d6c59153b69b03932da62f205646544164")**__

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that's what this fight is all about. __**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b4af40e1112648938ba3bd7b6a4521be&_e=ZAoFoqvZneQYz5p7Tu4U8wUb-gd8JcMSlIXsZbbjXtZRx48SoK9a6OhZ_jf2IU17ko2Jn6BjtWqZW0UCn7oZqBXHxggS9qKLvg9uarddAwNpazYQRvQPLo7-jf5MBUswVbQN8D8CDtS-Ou5R6tlC-o4fuVCcQ24Qy7rHxELPhu-vEVON0S0AEDx0Qd-g5iam_JhSJRYIYob1MR_bIsW_EJTGoNrnY6FONsrE-o2mwljSxyKAXRUjGpLjBrDNBdTwnuSRV5ulWL0JKyIouAOQf0RSb8Hgu9IvJTUovn0YJ_gXGWNWu8xy3Yodxd8OgQJwI7fs7XTBHUUIy4Ug2E3uJA%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a82b8a6f1a3d03523b43db6b553c5bda68e4f30d6b509c8b9925547b24af2737a9c0b13eb8b3e770ac8cd6a5aceb624ac59")**__

**It 's not about me, it's not about my opponent, it's about you - your business, your children's education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in its approach against the Left's radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers' unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist - you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I've only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. __**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b4af40e1112648938ba3bd7b6a4521be&_e=ZAoFoqvZneQYz5p7Tu4U8wUb-gd8JcMSlIXsZbbjXtZRx48SoK9a6OhZ_jf2IU17ko2Jn6BjtWqZW0UCn7oZqBXHxggS9qKLvg9uarddAwNpazYQRvQPLo7-jf5MBUswVbQN8D8CDtS-Ou5R6tlC-o4fuVCcQ24Qy7rHxELPhu-vEVON0S0AEDx0Qd-g5iamuOKXy-tqBfi5MLVN6f7OnjjH7rjJ1uILfjBocNf-fvVJZrd2g24pCtdZB3nZ-fioUrAcnh_n2auUcG6axXasbHQIl5nJiqJYif_BLQqgQ9k312uqzvr8XqGqj1AZbabJdWvuIaIWpSKIYwkdhBslsw%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a82ee90298480be1e70765f6d70f433b61f6562e3959ac8e03699ca3c1635e3a9cd7bf91b5e578c157e822512f9b87bfa44")**__

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business's ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and __**[stand with me in the fight against the Left's schemes and radical agenda. >>>>](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b4af40e1112648938ba3bd7b6a4521be&_e=ZAoFoqvZneQYz5p7Tu4U8wUb-gd8JcMSlIXsZbbjXtZRx48SoK9a6OhZ_jf2IU17ko2Jn6BjtWqZW0UCn7oZqBXHxggS9qKLvg9uarddAwNpazYQRvQPLo7-jf5MBUswVbQN8D8CDtS-Ou5R6tlC-o4fuVCcQ24Qy7rHxELPhu-vEVON0S0AEDx0Qd-g5iamPXOgw8cPzStmFvUUw8lsiLcerRW6gN70st1I8upC3DAwxO-13NHHP5g90-u8dcx2C-4i9iCROQ4IrKx2mUiChA1whPtNDuv9FxAeU4XLozMMC1gsDN1-708Ho9iLLnd0IOvjxB269h3L5F-tJ_wZhw%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a8281d926e974d43f54e1d1324cb0ec966cfe75389e7af10ce2c461b39aa31ec833dffbccf3a22fe2f24f49114ac33b18a0")**__
Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

Can I count on your si We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=8f51714726fa43f3931aae48ca8968f5&_e=7xWypSZkj5u2EJHOnsr_E9sEt1ZR5f-Ky5p1JjqFwX1VGRyKGPr4GvxKv4vb6oEGCCcKMngOcurxN3BaLK5-AHb51i-sF1UbGs6wZkkzBprekZ_VLBWFT0s2aCcXpMC7XCO7w9P371bxO1Ato5GaHlMPaSqXRutooJ8CEhTwvveNar7EunlBgMZKNF7X2DJuqtk5kqJRDUrFuIvo4YcPi88iPDVIBPBatcuYvzGLQ_svrY2X1lUkyol2RYcKx7cette4sno65jCTfF8vfz7KLUa9FMAkY9NKjbc9XrruDXMaz-XccHVphWcazsyOAxui)**

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Fellow Conservative,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden’s dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

| | Hi, it’s John Fetterman — Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania + Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate.

You wanna talk about why American elections are so messed up, Peter? Let’s start with the number 29, because it tells you everything you need to know.

**👉 The average donation to our campaign for U.S. Senate is $29.**

In order to raise all the money it takes to win this race for you + me + PA + the country, we’ve received a mind boggling 582,000 contributions. Now, you might be thinking: “Why the hell would John Fetterman need over 582,000 $29 donations”

This November, voters will have a choice: an extremist Trump-aligned Republican or Peter’s progressive voice

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=839%2E61531%2EP3gZRB)
Hello,
By now, we’re sure you’ve already heard of our Republican opponent, Gerald Malloy. In a moment, we’ll explain why he is the wrong choice for Vermont, but if you’re already convinced, [**will you chip in $5 or whatever you can right away?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3930?t=3&akid=839%2E61531%2EP3gZRB)
[CHIP IN ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3930?t=7&t=21&akid=839%2E61531%2EP3gZRB)
---
As Vermont’s Congressman, Peter has been working to deliver on our shared priorities—lowering prescription drug prices, protecting reproductive rights, a Green New Deal, and so much more. And he’s ready to get to work on Day One as Vermont’s next Senator.
His opponent, a Trump-aligned Republican who moved to Vermont just two years ago, has been doing the opposite. He’s been positioning himself as far right as possible, taking a strong stance against any additional gun control legislation and letting us know now that he would vote to ban abortions federally, with no exceptions.
**His policies are so extreme and anti-democratic—here’s what he had to say when asked about the January 6 insurrection:**
_**“I almost went there that day. I didn’t, but I wish I did.” – Gerald Malloy**_
**This November, voters will have a choice: an extremist Trump-aligned Republican or Peter’s progressive voice. And there’s simply too much at stake, we can’t afford to lose.**
Right now, our opponent claims to be fueled by a Super PAC—electing him would mean powerful outside interests in Vermont advancing Mitch McConnell’s and the GOP interests, against the interest of everyday Vermonters. We can’t let this happen.
It’s clear: McConnell, the GOP, and our extremist opponent are focused on winning this open seat in Vermont, because if they win here, Democrats will lose our Senate majority. With the future of our democracy at stake, we need to come together and ensure Peter is victorious.
**Our opponent already pulled off one major upset by winning the primary when no one, even Mitch McConnell, thought he could. With less than 90 days until election day, we need to show our strong support for Peter and send a message that our opponent's extremism isn't what Vermont is about.**
[**We can’t leave anything to chance with someone this extreme. Please chip in $5 or whatever you can to protect our Democratic majority and power this team to victory.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3930?t=4&akid=839%2E61531%2EP3gZRB)

Friend, I want to share an example of how our voting rights can be gradually eroded over time -- and how we can stop it.
Across the country, states have considered almost 400 voter suppression bills in 2022. The most extreme measures are often targeted and defeated early on. But those extreme bills also make somewhat less extreme bills seem reasonable by comparison.
It's an insidious trick, and a deliberate one: Flood the zone with lots of anti-voting rights bills, and hope one of them sneaks through. Fighting back against this strategy requires constant vigilance -- and that's where we need your help.

In November, freedom and choice are on the ballot, but we won't go back. Together, I know we can win these competitive races and hold onto the House majority. = Thank you again for your support, Pat Ryan | Yadira Caraveo is a pediatrician, state representative, and daughter of immigrants. Her parents raised her and her siblings on her father’s construction worker’s salary in Adams County. In the legislature, Dr. Caraveo has delivered for working Coloradans by standing up to the biggest corporate bullies and entrenched special interests. Now, Dr. Caraveo is running for Congress to stand up for hard-working families she sees falling through the cracks. Dr. Caraveo would be the first Latina to represent Colorado in Congress and the only physician in Colorado’s congressional delegation. = | = | PAID FOR BY CARAVEO FOR CONGRESS Caraveo for Congress PO Box 953 Eastlake, CO 80614 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please .

name: Val Demings
subject: I'm officially the Democratic nominee
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
We did it!
| We did it: **I'm officially the Democratic nominee in Florida's critical Senate race, and it's all thanks to the overwhelming support of this grassroots team.**

This is a massive step forward in our movement to flip Florida blue, but the road ahead will be the toughest yet - with recent polls showing Marco Rubio and me _tied_ heading into the general election, we can WIN. [**But in a race this tight, every dollar will make a difference. If you are committed to flipping Florida blue and defending our Senate majority, I'm personally asking you to become one of my first general election donors by rushing $5 now to split between my campaign and Voter Protection Project.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23240?t=6&akid=4220%2E878179%2EP5J-d9) There was nothing easy about getting to this moment. I grew up as a poor, Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith and belief in opportunity taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "Never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am.

There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate, nor was it easy to work my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.

My road to this moment - to winning Florida's Senate primary - was not easy, and there won't be anything easy about defeating Marco Rubio in November. But I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good for my community or of doing good for _you._

**I can't win this race alone, though. The real race begins now, so as we enter this final sprint to Election Day, I need you by my side more urgently than ever.** [**Please, will you rush $5 or more right now to split between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help me flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority? Every dollar you can chip in today will help us start the general election as strong as possible.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23240?t=7&akid=4220%2E878179%2EP5J-d9) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Val Demings and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23241?t=8&akid=4220%2E878179%2EP5J-d9)

I am so grateful for every bit of your support. Thank you.
